body.en: Elementary row operations preserve the solution set: swap equations, scale by a nonzero number, or add a multiple of another equation.
body.zh: 交换方程、非零数乘方程或加另一方程倍数，都保持解集。

body.en: Linear algebra studies combinations formed by adding vectors and multiplying them by scalars. A linear map preserves these two operations, so knowing its action on a basis determines it everywhere. Matrices describe such maps after bases are chosen; changing a basis changes coordinates without changing the underlying map. Elimination exposes consistency, free variables, and pivot columns. Dimension counts independent directions, while determinants describe signed volume scaling for square maps. Eigenvectors identify directions that the map only scales. Always state the ambient vector space and scalar field, and distinguish the matrix shape from properties that require a square matrix.
body.zh: 线性代数研究向量相加和数乘组成的组合。线性映射保持这两种运算，因此知道基上的作用便确定全部作用。矩阵依选定的基描述映射，换基改变坐标却不改变映射本身。消元揭示相容性、自由变量和主元列。维数计独立方向，行列式描述方阵的有向体积缩放，特征向量给只被缩放的方向。须说明向量空间、数域和矩阵形状，方阵性质不能随意用于矩形矩阵。

body.en: A row 0=1 signals inconsistency; a zero row alone does not imply a unique solution.
body.zh: 0=1表示不相容，零行本身不表示唯一解。

body.en: Linear algebra studies combinations formed by adding vectors and multiplying them by scalars. A linear map preserves these two operations, so knowing its action on a basis determines it everywhere. Matrices describe such maps after bases are chosen; changing a basis changes coordinates without changing the underlying map. Elimination exposes consistency, free variables, and pivot columns. Dimension counts independent directions, while determinants describe signed volume scaling for square maps. Eigenvectors identify directions that the map only scales. Always state the ambient vector space and scalar field, and distinguish the matrix shape from properties that require a square matrix.
body.zh: 线性代数研究向量相加和数乘组成的组合。线性映射保持这两种运算，因此知道基上的作用便确定全部作用。矩阵依选定的基描述映射，换基改变坐标却不改变映射本身。消元揭示相容性、自由变量和主元列。维数计独立方向，行列式描述方阵的有向体积缩放，特征向量给只被缩放的方向。须说明向量空间、数域和矩阵形状，方阵性质不能随意用于矩形矩阵。

body.en: An inner product defines squared length ⟨v,v⟩. Gram-Schmidt subtracts projections onto earlier orthonormal directions.
body.zh: 内积给平方长度⟨v,v⟩；施密特过程减去前面正交归一方向上的投影。

body.en: Once a vector space has an inner product, lengths and angles allow approximation problems to be formulated geometrically. Orthogonality separates independent contributions to squared length. Projection finds the nearest vector in a subspace by requiring the residual to be orthogonal to that subspace. Spectral decompositions reveal how a map stretches special directions, while singular values extend that idea to rectangular maps. Coordinate transformations can simplify a quadratic form without changing its geometric meaning. Distinguish exact algebraic rank from numerical rank estimated using a tolerance, since tiny singular values can magnify data errors even when a formal inverse exists.
body.zh: 赋予内积后，向量空间具有长度与角，近似问题可几何化。正交使平方长度分解；投影要求残差垂直子空间，从而找最近向量。谱分解揭示特殊方向的拉伸，奇异值将它扩展到矩形矩阵。换坐标可简化二次型而不改变几何意义。精确代数秩与按容差估计的数值秩须区分：即使形式上可逆，极小奇异值也会放大数据误差。

body.en: An inner product must be positive definite; an arbitrary bilinear expression may not be one.
body.zh: 内积必须正定，任意双线性表达式未必是内积。

objectives.en: Apply calorimetry and check hess law.
objectives.zh: 应用量热，并检查赫斯定律。

body.en: Separate the system from its surroundings before assigning a heat sign. Heat entering the system is positive; an exothermic reaction transfers heat outward and has negative enthalpy change under the usual constant-pressure conditions. Internal energy includes microscopic energy storage, whereas enthalpy adds the pressure–volume term needed for convenient constant-pressure accounting. A calorimeter infers transferred heat from a measured temperature change using heat capacity. For a solution, q = mcΔT is an approximation requiring an appropriate specific heat and allowance for the container’s own heat capacity. The reacting system’s heat is opposite to the surroundings’ heat when other losses are negligible. Hess’s law allows equations to be reversed, multiplied and added: reverse the enthalpy sign when reversing an equation and multiply the enthalpy when scaling its coefficients. Standard formation enthalpies describe forming one mole of a substance from elements in their specified reference states. Sum product coefficients times formation enthalpies and subtract the corresponding reactant sum. Always retain phase labels: liquid water and water vapour have different enthalpies, so silently changing the phase changes the problem.
body.zh: 指定热量符号前先区分系统与环境。进入系统的热为正；通常恒压条件下，放热反应向外传热，焓变为负。内能描述微观储能，焓增加 pV 项，便于恒压核算。量热计由温度变化与热容推断热量。溶液 q = mcΔT 是近似，需选合适比热并考虑容器热容；若其他损失可忽略，反应系统的热与环境的热互为相反数。赫斯定律允许方程反向、倍乘、相加：反向时焓变变号，倍乘系数时焓变也倍乘。标准生成焓对应元素从指定参考态生成一摩尔物质。按系数求产物生成焓总和，再减反应物总和。相态标签必须保留，液态水与水蒸气焓不同，暗中换相态就是改变问题。

title.zh: 焓 · 量热 · 赫斯定律

body.en: Enthalpy H = U + pV is a state function. At constant pressure with only pressure–volume work, heat equals enthalpy change. Hess’s law adds reaction enthalpies because state-function differences depend only on endpoints.
body.zh: 焓 H = U + pV 是状态函数。恒压且仅有体积功时，热等于焓变。赫斯定律可将反应焓相加，因为状态函数差只取决于始末态。

body.en: Two consecutive reaction steps have enthalpies −40 and +15 kJ. Find total in kJ. Apply the relation step by step: ΔHtotal = −40 + 15 = −25 kJ. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 连续两步反应焓为 −40 和 +15 kJ，总焓变为多少 kJ？逐步代入关系：ΔHtotal = −40 + 15 = −25 kJ.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “Enthalpy change is unchanged when the reaction is reversed.” is not valid. Reversing a reaction reverses its enthalpy-change sign. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “反应反转时焓变不变。”并不成立。反转反应会反转焓变符号。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

Change one parameter and predict the direction of the result before calculating. This separates understanding of a model from memorizing one numerical answer. This introductory survey establishes the named ideas; extended derivations, laboratory competence and comprehensive examination preparation require further study and review.

summary.en: At constant temperature and pressure, a negative reaction Gibbs-energy change favors forward change under the stated composition.
summary.zh: 恒温恒压下，给定组成的反应吉布斯能变为负时，正向变化有利。

objectives.en: Explain entropy using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释熵。

objectives.en: Apply gibbs energy and check spontaneity conditions.
objectives.zh: 应用吉布斯能，并检查自发条件。

body.en: Entropy measures how energy and matter can be distributed among compatible microscopic states; calling it disorder is at best an incomplete analogy. Melting, mixing and gas expansion often increase entropy because more configurations become accessible, but a complete calculation must consider the specific process. The second law constrains total entropy of system plus surroundings. At constant temperature and pressure, Gibbs energy packages that total-entropy criterion into a system property. In ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, use kelvin and matching energy units. A reaction with positive enthalpy can still be favorable if the entropy term is sufficiently large. Standard reaction Gibbs energy refers to specified standard activities, while actual reaction Gibbs energy depends on current composition through ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q. Equilibrium is reached when the reaction Gibbs-energy change becomes zero, not when the system’s total Gibbs energy is literally zero. Thermodynamic favorability gives a direction under stated constraints; activation barriers can make a favorable transformation extremely slow. Diamonds and combustible fuels illustrate why a driving force and a kinetic pathway must be considered separately.
body.zh: 熵衡量能量和物质在相容微观态间分配的可能性，“混乱度”最多是不完整类比。熔化、混合和气体膨胀常使可及构型增加，但完整计算须针对具体过程。第二定律约束系统加环境的总熵。恒温恒压下，吉布斯能把总熵判据转化为系统性质。ΔG = ΔH − TΔS 中须用开尔文及匹配的能量单位。焓变为正的反应，若熵项足够大，仍可有利。标准反应吉布斯能对应标准活度，实际值则通过 ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q 依赖组成。平衡意味着反应吉布斯能变为零，不是系统总吉布斯能数值为零。热力学给出指定约束下的方向，但活化势垒可使有利变化极慢，因此驱动力与动力学途径必须分别考虑。

title.zh: 熵 · 吉布斯能 · 自发条件

body.en: At constant temperature and pressure, a negative reaction Gibbs-energy change favors forward change under the stated composition. ΔG = ΔH − TΔS combines energetic and entropic contributions. Favorability does not specify reaction speed.
body.zh: 恒温恒压下，给定组成的反应吉布斯能变为负时，正向变化有利。ΔG = ΔH − TΔS 综合能量与熵贡献，但有利性不决定速率。

body.en: ΔH = 10 kJ, T = 300 K and ΔS = 0.05 kJ/K. Find ΔG in kJ. Apply the relation step by step: ΔG = 10 − 300 × 0.05 = −5 kJ. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: ΔH = 10 kJ，T = 300 K，ΔS = 0.05 kJ/K，ΔG 为多少 kJ？逐步代入关系：ΔG = 10 − 300 × 0.05 = −5 kJ.并检查单位与假设。

objectives.en: Apply reaction quotient and check mass action.
objectives.zh: 应用反应商，并检查质量作用。

body.en: A reversible reaction can proceed in both directions while its macroscopic composition remains constant. At equilibrium the two rates match; individual molecules continue to react. For a reaction aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD, the reaction quotient uses product activities raised to c and d divided by reactant activities raised to a and b. Activities are dimensionless effective concentrations relative to standard states. Concentrations or partial pressures can approximate them in suitable dilute or ideal conditions. Pure condensed phases usually have unit activity while present, which is why their amounts do not appear explicitly in the simplest equilibrium expression. Changing a reaction’s direction inverts K; multiplying all coefficients by a factor raises K to that factor. At a fixed temperature K is a property of the specified reaction, while Q changes as composition changes. Adding a reactant can therefore change Q without changing K. A catalyst accelerates approach in both directions but does not alter the equilibrium constant. Temperature changes can change K, and pressure changes influence gas equilibria through composition and volume rather than a universal rule that every reaction shifts the same way.
body.zh: 可逆反应可持续双向进行，而宏观组成保持恒定。平衡时正逆速率相等，分子仍在反应。对 aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD，反应商为产物活度按系数乘方之积，除以反应物对应之积。活度是相对标准态的无量纲有效浓度；合适稀溶液或理想条件下可用浓度或分压近似。纯凝聚相存在时通常取单位活度，因此其量不显式出现。反向反应使 K 取倒数，全部系数乘某因子则 K 乘相应幂。温度固定时，K 属于指定反应，而 Q 随组成改变；加反应物可改变 Q 而不改变 K。催化剂加速两个方向接近平衡，不改变 K。温度可改变 K，压强通过气体组成与体积影响平衡，不能机械认为所有反应都朝同一方向移动。

body.en: The reaction quotient Q uses current activities with stoichiometric exponents. At equilibrium Q = K. If Q < K, forward change is favored until equilibrium is approached; pure solid activities are normally one.
body.zh: 反应商 Q 用当前活度及计量指数计算，平衡时 Q = K。Q < K 时正向变化有利；通常纯固体活度为一。

body.en: For A ⇌ B with K = 4, equilibrium activity of A is 0.2. Find activity of B. Apply the relation step by step: K = aB/aA; aB = 4 × 0.2 = 0.8. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: A ⇌ B 的 K = 4，平衡时 A 活度为 0.2，B 活度是多少？逐步代入关系：K = aB/aA; aB = 4 × 0.2 = 0.8.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: Acid and base labels describe a reaction role. A Brønsted acid donates H+ to a base, producing its conjugate base and the base’s conjugate acid. Water can play either role. For a weak acid HA, Ka describes HA + H2O ⇌ H3O+ + A− with water activity absorbed into the convention. A smaller pKa means a larger Ka and a stronger acid under comparable conditions. Strong and weak refer to dissociation tendency; concentrated and dilute refer to amount per volume. The pH definition uses hydrogen-ion activity, so the familiar negative logarithm of concentration is an ideal dilute approximation. A buffer contains appreciable amounts of a weak acid and its conjugate base. Added acid is consumed mainly by the base component, while added base consumes the acid component. The Henderson–Hasselbalch relation connects pH to pKa and the conjugate-pair activity ratio, but it presumes the relevant equilibrium description is valid. Buffer capacity is finite: near exhaustion of one component, a small addition can cause a large pH change. A titration equivalence point concerns stoichiometric consumption and is not automatically pH seven.
body.zh: 酸碱标签描述反应角色。布朗斯特酸向碱供出 H+，生成其共轭碱与原碱的共轭酸；水可扮演任一角色。弱酸 HA 的 Ka 描述 HA + H2O ⇌ H3O+ + A−，水活度吸收到约定中。可比条件下，pKa 越小、Ka 越大、酸越强。强弱描述解离倾向，浓稀描述单位体积含量。pH 严格使用氢离子活度，浓度负对数是理想稀溶液近似。缓冲液含显著量弱酸及其共轭碱；加酸主要被碱组分消耗，加碱主要消耗酸组分。亨德森—哈塞尔巴尔赫关系联系 pH、pKa 与共轭对活度比，但需相关平衡模型成立。缓冲容量有限，一种组分接近耗尽时，少量加入就可导致大幅 pH 改变。滴定等当点表示计量消耗完成，并不自动等于 pH 七。

summary.zh: 溶度积描述与固体平衡的离子活度。

objectives.en: Explain solubility product using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释溶度积。

objectives.en: Apply ion product and check complex formation.
objectives.zh: 应用离子积，并检查配合物形成。

body.en: Solubility is a total dissolved amount under specified conditions, whereas a solubility product is an equilibrium constant written in terms of particular free-ion activities. For a salt producing unequal numbers of ions, the stoichiometric powers matter: AB2 gives a product involving one A activity and the square of B activity. In pure water with no other reactions, those activities can sometimes be related directly to a single molar-solubility variable. A common ion changes the starting composition and usually suppresses dissolution in the simple model, so the pure-water square-root shortcut is no longer valid. Compare the current ion product with Ksp to predict whether a solution is undersaturated, saturated or thermodynamically supersaturated. Nucleation barriers can delay visible precipitation even when it is favorable. Ligands form complexes with metal ions and reduce the free-ion activity at a given total metal concentration. This can drive additional solid dissolution. Acid–base reactions may similarly remove a dissolved ion, coupling pH and solubility. Distinguish free metal, complexed metal and total dissolved metal, and use material balances to connect them.

body.en: A coupled-equilibrium problem cannot usually be solved by treating every reaction as if the others did not exist. List the chemically distinct species first, then write independent equilibrium relations and analytical totals. A material balance counts each conserved element or component across all its species; a charge balance sums positive and negative ionic charge in the bulk solution. Water autoionization may need inclusion when acid or base concentrations are very small. Choose unknowns that reduce redundancy, such as free hydrogen-ion concentration and free ligand concentration, and express other species through equilibrium ratios. Approximations are hypotheses: neglecting a dissociated amount against the starting concentration must be checked after obtaining the tentative result. The common five-percent criterion is a rough classroom tolerance, not a universal scientific law. When it fails, retain the term and solve the resulting quadratic or numerical system. Also check positivity, conservation totals and whether the assumed dominant species actually dominates. A mathematically real root can be physically impossible if it implies negative concentration or consumes more material than was available.
body.zh: 耦合平衡不能通常把每个反应当作其他反应不存在来解。先列不同物种，再写独立平衡关系与分析总量。物料守恒在所有物种中计数每个保守元素或组分，电荷守恒则平衡溶液正负离子电荷。酸碱极稀时，须计入水自解离。可选择游离氢离子或配体浓度为未知量，通过平衡比表达其他物种，以减少冗余。近似是待检验假设：忽略解离量相对于初浓度，必须求出试算值后检查。常见百分之五规则只是课堂粗略容差，不是普适科学定律。若不满足，应保留该项并解二次或数值方程。还须检查浓度非负、总量守恒以及假定优势物种是否真占优。数学实根若给出负浓度或消耗量超过库存，便不具物理意义。

body.en: A substance has a reproducible chemical identity; its physical state may still change. Ice, liquid water and water vapour all contain H2O, whereas hydrogen peroxide contains different molecules and is a different substance. An element is defined by proton number, not by whether it appears as single atoms: oxygen gas commonly contains O2 molecules but is still an element. A compound has constituent atoms chemically combined, so separating it into elements requires chemical change. Mixtures can have variable composition: salty water can be dilute or concentrated without creating a new compound. A homogeneous mixture looks uniform at the chosen scale; a suspension contains distinguishable dispersed material. Physical separation exploits a property difference. Filtration retains particles too large for pores but does not remove dissolved ions. Distillation uses volatility differences, and chromatography uses different affinities for moving and stationary phases. Select the method from particle size, solubility or volatility, rather than from the colour of the sample. A separation can fail when the relevant properties are too similar or when heating changes the substances chemically.
body.zh: 物质具有可重复的化学身份，但物态可以变化。冰、液态水和水蒸气都含 H2O；过氧化氢具有不同分子，是另一种物质。元素由质子数定义，不取决于是否以单原子存在；氧气通常含 O2 分子，仍是元素单质。化合物中原子发生化学结合，拆成元素需要化学变化。混合物组成可变，盐水变浓或变稀不意味着产生新化合物。均相混合物在选定尺度上均匀，悬浊液则有可区分的分散物。物理分离利用性质差异：过滤截留大于孔径的颗粒，却不能去除溶解离子；蒸馏利用挥发性差异，色谱利用对流动相与固定相的亲和差异。应根据粒径、溶解度或挥发性选择方法，而非只凭颜色。当性质过于相似，或加热引发化学变化时，分离方法可能失败。

body.en: Chemical amounts require three distinct levels: the mass of one microscopic entity, a count of entities, and the mass of a macroscopic sample. Relative atomic mass compares an atom with one twelfth of the carbon-12 atomic mass; it is dimensionless. Molar mass instead has units such as grams per mole. Isotopes share proton number but differ in neutron number, so a natural sample can contain atoms with different masses. A tabulated average is the abundance-weighted mean, not the mass of a special average isotope. The mole is a counting unit like a dozen but vastly larger. Always specify atoms, molecules, ions or formula units. The molar mass of H2O is obtained by adding two hydrogen contributions and one oxygen contribution. To find elemental mass percentage, divide the element’s total mass contribution in one formula amount by the compound’s molar mass. Conversely, empirical formulas follow by converting each elemental mass to moles, dividing by the smallest amount and seeking a simple whole-number ratio. An empirical formula gives a ratio; a molecular formula additionally needs molecular molar mass.
body.zh: 化学计量应区分单个微观实体质量、实体个数和宏观样品质量。相对原子质量以碳-12 原子质量的十二分之一为基准，是无量纲比值；摩尔质量则有 g/mol 等单位。同位素质子数相同、中子数不同，自然样品可能混有不同质量原子。表列平均值是丰度加权平均，不代表一种特殊“平均同位素”。摩尔像打一样是计数单位，但数量巨大，必须指定原子、分子、离子或化学式单元。H2O 摩尔质量由两个氢和一个氧的贡献相加得到。元素质量百分比等于一个化学式量中该元素的质量贡献除以化合物摩尔质量。反求实验式时，先把各元素质量换成摩尔数，再除以最小值，寻找简单整数比。实验式只给比例，分子式还需要分子摩尔质量。

body.en: A chemical equation states which species disappear and appear, along with their relative amounts. The formula of each species records its identity; changing a subscript changes that identity. Balancing therefore changes only the multipliers placed before formulas. Start by listing the number of atoms of each element on both sides. Choose coefficients so each inventory agrees, then reduce to the smallest convenient whole-number set. For ions, perform a separate charge count: conserving atoms alone is insufficient. State symbols such as solid, liquid, gas and aqueous distinguish phases and help determine whether a net ionic reaction occurs. In a net ionic equation, spectator ions that remain unchanged on both sides are removed. Coefficients describe amount ratios, not mass ratios; equal coefficients can correspond to very different masses because molar masses differ. They also do not generally give a rate law: a reaction may occur through several hidden steps. In stoichiometric calculations, convert the supplied mass or concentration into amount first, apply the coefficient ratio, and only then convert to the requested final quantity.
body.zh: 化学方程说明哪些物种消失、哪些出现，以及相对数量。化学式记录物种身份，改变下标就改变物质，因此配平只改化学式前的系数。先列两侧各元素原子数，再选择系数使每项库存一致，最后化为方便的最简整数比。离子反应还需独立计算总电荷，仅原子守恒不够。固、液、气、水溶液等状态符号区分相态，并帮助判断净离子反应。净离子方程中可约去两侧不变的旁观离子。计量系数给物质的量比而非质量比，因为摩尔质量不同。系数通常也不能直接给速率定律，反应可能经历多个隐藏步骤。计算时先把给定质量或浓度转换为物质的量，使用系数比，再转为目标量。

body.en: Balance equations by changing coefficients, never the formulas of participating species. Coefficients give amount ratios for the stated reaction. Ionic equations must conserve total electric charge as well as every element.

summary.en: Compare initial amounts divided by stoichiometric coefficients to identify the limiting reagent.
summary.zh: 把初始物质的量除以计量系数并比较，最小比值确定限量试剂及最大反应进度。

objectives.en: Explain reaction extent using the stated model.

objectives.en: Apply limiting reagent and check percent yield.
objectives.zh: 应用限量试剂，并检查产率。

body.en: A balanced reaction can be imagined as a recipe applied repeatedly. If a recipe consumes two units of A for every one unit of B, three units of A cannot consume three units of B completely. Define a trial reaction extent by dividing each available reactant amount by the number of units it consumes per recipe. The smallest value limits how many complete recipe units can occur. Multiply that extent by each product coefficient to obtain the theoretical amount, assuming the stated reaction goes to completion with no competing reaction. Remaining excess reactant equals its initial amount minus the coefficient times the extent. Actual product may be lower because of incomplete reaction, side reactions, transfer losses or purification losses. Percentage yield compares an actual isolated amount with the theoretical amount on the same mass or mole basis. A value above one hundred percent often indicates wet or impure product, an incorrect assumed composition, or measurement error. It is a reason to investigate the calculation and sample, not evidence that atom conservation failed.
body.zh: 配平方程可以看作反复使用的配方。若每份反应消耗两份 A 和一份 B，三份 A 不可能完全消耗三份 B。将各反应物初始物质的量除以其计量系数，最小值限制可进行的反应份数，即反应进度。用该值乘产物系数得到理论产量，前提是所述反应完成且无竞争反应。过量试剂剩余量为初始量减去系数乘反应进度。实际产量可因未完全反应、副反应、转移或纯化损失而降低。百分产率应在相同质量或摩尔基准上比较实际分离量与理论量。超过百分之百通常提示产物潮湿、不纯、组成假设错误或测量误差，应检查样品与计算，而不是认为原子守恒失效。

summary.en: Molarity is dissolved amount per solution volume, usually mol/L.
summary.zh: 物质的量浓度为溶质物质的量除以溶液体积，常用 mol/L。

objectives.en: Explain molarity using the stated model.

objectives.en: Apply dilution and check solution volume.
objectives.zh: 应用稀释，并检查溶液体积。

body.en: A solution is a single phase containing a solvent and one or more dissolved solutes. Dissolution distributes particles through the solvent; it does not mean the particles have disappeared. Molarity is an amount concentration and depends on total solution volume, so temperature-driven expansion can change molarity even when solute amount remains fixed. Mass fraction uses masses and is less directly sensitive to such volume changes. Molality uses moles per kilogram of solvent and must not be confused with molarity. To prepare a specified solution, determine the required solute amount, convert to mass if appropriate, dissolve it in less than the final volume, and then adjust the final solution volume. The equation c1V1 = c2V2 is an amount balance, not an independent law of liquids. It requires the same conserved solute and no reaction or loss. Mixing different reacting solutions requires stoichiometric accounting before a final concentration is reported. Keep volume units consistent within a ratio and convert to litres when multiplying a concentration expressed per litre to obtain moles.
body.zh: 溶液是溶剂与一种或多种溶质构成的单一相。溶解使粒子分散在溶剂中，并不是粒子消失。物质的量浓度使用溶液总体积，温度引起体积膨胀时，即使溶质量不变，浓度也会改变。质量分数用质量，较少直接受体积变化影响。质量摩尔浓度用每千克溶剂中的摩尔数，不能与物质的量浓度混淆。配液时先确定所需溶质量，必要时换算为质量，先溶于少于终体积的溶剂，再定容。c1V1 = c2V2 是物质的量守恒关系，要求同一溶质不反应也不损失。混合能反应的溶液时，应先做计量核算，再报告终浓度。比值中的体积单位要一致；若浓度单位为每升，乘体积求摩尔数时需使用升。

body.en: Molarity is dissolved amount per solution volume, usually mol/L. Dilution conserves solute amount when none reacts or is lost, so c1V1 = c2V2. Final solution volume is not always the sum of component volumes.

objectives.en: Explain ideal gas equation using the stated model.

objectives.en: Apply partial pressure and check model range.
objectives.zh: 应用分压，并检查模型范围。

body.en: Gas pressure results from particle momentum transfer to container walls. Increasing particle amount at fixed temperature and volume increases collision frequency and hence pressure in the ideal model. Increasing absolute temperature raises the typical particle kinetic energy, while increasing volume reduces the collision rate per area. The ideal equation combines these trends with a proportionality constant R whose numerical value depends on the chosen pressure and volume units. Never mix a value of R in litre atmospheres with pressures in pascals without conversion. An ideal mixture treats each component as if it occupied the full container independently at the same temperature. Its partial pressure is therefore proportional to its mole fraction, and summing all partial pressures returns the total. Gas collected over water includes water vapour; subtract the appropriate vapour pressure before attributing all pressure to the desired gas. At high density, finite molecular volume and intermolecular attractions become important. Near condensation, the ideal approximation can fail dramatically, so always identify temperature, pressure and phase before using a simple gas calculation.
body.zh: 气体压强源于粒子向容器壁传递动量。理想模型中，温度与体积不变时粒子数增加，碰撞频率和压强增加；绝对温度升高增加典型粒子动能，体积增大则减少单位面积碰撞率。理想气体方程把这些趋势结合，R 的数值取决于压强与体积单位。不能把以 L·atm 为单位的 R 与 Pa 压强未经换算混用。理想混合物中，每种组分都视为在同温下独立占满容器，因此分压与摩尔分数成正比，分压之和为总压。排水集气含水蒸气，应先减去对应蒸气压，不能把总压都归给目标气体。高密度下，分子有限体积和吸引力变得重要；接近冷凝时理想近似可严重失效，列式前应识别温度、压强和相态。

body.en: For dilute gases, pV = nRT links amount with pressure, volume and absolute temperature. Ideal-mixture partial pressures add; each equals mole fraction times total pressure. High pressure and condensation can invalidate the ideal model.

body.en: A gas has mole fraction 0.25 in a 200 kPa ideal mixture. Find its partial pressure in kPa. Apply the relation step by step: pi = xi ptotal = 0.25 × 200 = 50 kPa. Check the units and the assumptions used.

summary.en: Scattering supports a compact positive nucleus; line spectra support discrete electronic energies.
summary.zh: 散射支持紧凑正电原子核，线光谱支持离散电子能级。

objectives.en: Explain nucleus using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释原子核。

objectives.en: Apply electron shells and check spectral evidence.
objectives.zh: 应用电子层，并检查光谱证据。

body.en: Rutherford-type scattering showed that most atomic volume does not contain concentrated positive mass: most fast projectiles pass through, while a small fraction undergo large deflections near a compact nucleus. Nuclear proton number identifies the element, and neutron number distinguishes isotopes. Electron number determines ionic charge together with proton number. The classical picture of an orbiting charge cannot account for stable atomic spectra. In the quantum description, an orbital is a state with a spatial probability distribution and allowed energy. Principal shells contain subshells with different angular structure; each spatial orbital permits two electrons with opposite spin labels. The Pauli principle forbids two identical electrons from occupying the same complete state. Hund’s rule favors separate occupation of equal-energy orbitals before pairing in the introductory ground-state model. Aufbau ordering is a useful construction rule, but closely spaced levels cause exceptions, especially for transition elements and ions. An emitted photon carries the difference between two levels, so separate spectral lines provide evidence of energy differences. A line does not reveal an electron’s classical circular path.
body.zh: 卢瑟福式散射表明，原子大部分体积中没有集中正电质量：多数高速粒子直接穿过，少数靠近紧凑原子核时发生大角偏转。质子数识别元素，中子数区分同位素，电子数与质子数共同决定离子电荷。经典绕核运动不能解释稳定原子光谱。量子描述中，轨道是具有空间概率分布和允许能量的态。主电子层包含角结构不同的亚层，每个空间轨道可容纳两个自旋标签相反的电子。泡利原理禁止电子占据同一完整状态，洪特规则在入门基态模型中使等能轨道先单独占据再配对。构造原理是实用规则，但能级接近会造成例外，尤其在过渡元素与离子中。发射光子的能量等于两个能级差，离散谱线由此提供能量差证据，并不揭示电子经典圆轨道。

title.zh: 原子核 · 电子层 · 光谱证据

body.en: Scattering supports a compact positive nucleus; line spectra support discrete electronic energies. Orbitals describe quantum probability distributions, not tiny planetary paths. Electron configurations fill allowed states subject to exclusion and energy ordering.

body.en: Periodic organization follows the repeating pattern of valence-electron configurations. Elements in a group often show related chemistry because their outer-electron patterns resemble one another, although extra shells change size and shielding. Moving down a group generally adds a shell, placing outer electrons farther from the nucleus. Moving across a period adds protons while electrons enter the same principal shell, so the effective attraction commonly rises. Atomic radius is not a uniquely sharp boundary; covalent, metallic and van der Waals radii are operational definitions obtained in different contexts. Ionization energy is the energy required to remove an electron from a gaseous species. Successive ionizations become harder, and a large jump can reveal removal from a filled inner shell. Electron affinity concerns adding an electron and has sign conventions that must be checked. Electronegativity describes attraction to shared electron density within a bond, not an isolated-atom radius or charge. Subshell energies, electron pairing and imperfect shielding create important exceptions to simple trends, so explain a comparison mechanistically instead of memorizing arrows alone.
body.zh: 周期组织来自价电子排布的重复。同族元素外层模式相似，常有相近化学性质，但新增电子层会改变大小与屏蔽。沿族向下通常增加电子层，外层电子离核更远；沿周期增加质子而电子仍进入相同主层，有效吸引通常加强。原子半径并非唯一锐利边界，共价、金属和范德华半径是在不同情境中定义的操作量。电离能是从气态物种移去电子所需能量。连续电离越来越困难，大跃升可提示开始移除内层电子。电子亲和能涉及加入电子，应检查符号约定；电负性描述成键时对共享电子密度的吸引，不等同孤立原子半径或电荷。亚层能量、电子配对与不完全屏蔽造成趋势例外，因此应解释机理，而非只背箭头。

body.en: Chemical bonding reflects a lower total energy for some arrangements of nuclei and electrons than for the corresponding separated species. Attraction alone is insufficient: at very short separations, repulsion raises the energy and establishes an equilibrium bond distance. In an ionic lattice, each ion interacts with many surrounding ions, so one should not picture sodium chloride as isolated NaCl pairs. Charge magnitude and ionic separation influence electrostatic lattice stabilization. A covalent description emphasizes shared electron density between nuclei, with single, double and triple bonds representing different idealized shared-electron patterns. A coordinate bond denotes a bookkeeping origin for the shared pair; after formation it is not a fundamentally different force. Metallic bonding describes electrons distributed through a lattice, helping explain electrical conduction and the ability of layers to slide without destroying every bond. Electronegativity differences shift electron density continuously, so ionic and covalent labels are useful limits rather than rigid categories. Lewis structures track valence electrons and formal charges; formal charge is a bookkeeping assignment and should not automatically be interpreted as a measured atomic charge.

body.en: Molecular shape begins with connectivity: identify which atoms are joined before counting electron domains around a chosen central atom. In the basic VSEPR model, each single, double or triple bond counts as one directional domain, while each lone pair counts as another. Two domains favor a linear arrangement, three a trigonal planar arrangement and four a tetrahedral arrangement. Molecular geometry names the positions of atoms rather than all electron domains, so four domains with one lone pair give a trigonal pyramidal molecule, not a tetrahedral molecular shape. Lone pairs and multiple bonds can shift angles away from ideal values because their electron distributions differ. A bond dipole combines magnitude and direction; determine molecular polarity by adding these dipoles as vectors in the actual geometry. Linear carbon dioxide can have polar bonds whose dipoles cancel, whereas bent water does not have that cancellation. Symmetry is therefore as important as electronegativity. VSEPR is an introductory predictive model, not a universal quantitative theory: delocalization, transition-metal coordination and electronic-state changes may require orbital-based explanations or experimental structure data.
body.zh: 分子构型先从连接关系开始：先确定哪些原子相连，再数中心原子周围电子域。基础 VSEPR 模型中，单、双、三键各算一个方向性电子域，每对孤电子对另算一个。两个域倾向直线，三个域倾向平面三角形，四个域倾向四面体。分子构型命名只看原子位置，所以四个域中含一对孤电子对时为三角锥形，而非四面体分子构型。孤电子对与多重键的电子分布不同，会使键角偏离理想值。键偶极有大小和方向，应按实际构型作矢量叠加判断分子极性。直线 CO2 的极性键偶极可抵消，弯曲水分子则不能；对称性与电负性同样重要。VSEPR 是入门预测模型，不是普遍定量理论，离域、过渡金属配位与电子态变化可能需要轨道解释或实验结构。

body.en: Intermolecular forces act between molecules and must be distinguished from the bonds that hold each molecule together. London dispersion arises because instantaneous charge fluctuations in one species correlate with fluctuations in another. Greater polarizability and favorable contact area often strengthen dispersion, which exists even in nonpolar substances. Permanent molecular dipoles add interactions whose strengths depend on orientation and separation. Hydrogen bonding is a directional interaction involving a hydrogen attached to an appropriate electronegative donor and an available acceptor; merely containing hydrogen is insufficient. These interactions collectively influence boiling point, viscosity, surface tension, solubility and crystal packing. A higher boiling point can indicate stronger effective cohesion, but molecular size, shape and phase structure must also be considered. Dissolution involves replacing solute–solute and solvent–solvent interactions with solute–solvent interactions, together with entropy changes, so “like dissolves like” is only a heuristic. A solid’s properties may instead be dominated by a covalent network, ionic lattice or metallic electrons. Always identify the structural level before using the phrase weak intermolecular force to explain a material.
body.zh: 分子间作用与分子内部化学键必须区分。伦敦色散源于不同物种瞬时电荷涨落的关联；可极化性更大、接触面积更有利时，作用常更强，非极性物质也有色散力。永久偶极增加依赖取向与距离的相互作用。氢键是有方向性的作用，需要氢连接适当电负性供体，并有可用受体，仅含氢并不足够。这些作用共同影响沸点、黏度、表面张力、溶解度和晶体堆积。较高沸点可提示更强内聚，但还须考虑大小、形状和相结构。溶解把溶质—溶质、溶剂—溶剂作用替换为溶质—溶剂作用，同时涉及熵变，因此“相似相溶”只是经验指导。有些固体性质主要由共价网络、离子晶格或金属电子决定。解释材料时应先明确结构层次，不能一律归于弱分子间作用。

title.zh: 原子轨道与分子轨道入门

summary.en: Atomic orbitals combine into molecular orbitals with different energies and spatial distributions.
summary.zh: 原子轨道组合为能量与空间分布不同的分子轨道。

objectives.en: Explain orbital overlap using the stated model.

objectives.en: Apply bonding and antibonding and check bond order.

body.en: An atomic orbital describes an allowed one-electron spatial state associated with an atom. When atoms approach, compatible orbital combinations extend over more than one nucleus. Constructive combination can increase electron density between nuclei and lower energy, producing a bonding molecular orbital; destructive combination introduces a node and often raises energy, producing an antibonding orbital. The number of molecular orbitals formed equals the number of atomic orbitals combined in the chosen basis. Fill the resulting states according to their energies, Pauli exclusion and the applicable spin rules. The introductory bond-order expression counts bonding electrons minus antibonding electrons, divided by two. It summarizes net stabilization in simple cases but does not replace a complete energy calculation. Unpaired electrons imply paramagnetic behavior, which can distinguish molecular-orbital predictions from overly simple Lewis pictures, as in oxygen. Sigma orbitals have symmetry around the bond axis, while pi orbitals have a nodal plane containing that axis. Orbital diagrams are model representations rather than photographs, and their ordering can depend on the atoms involved; copying one ordering indiscriminately across all molecules can give incorrect conclusions.
body.zh: 原子轨道描述与原子相关的允许单电子空间态。原子接近时，相容轨道组合可延伸到多个核。相长组合能增加核间电子密度并降低能量，形成成键轨道；相消组合引入节点，常抬高能量，形成反键轨道。在选定基组中，形成的分子轨道数等于参与组合的原子轨道数。按能量、泡利原理与适用自旋规则填充。入门键级公式为成键电子数减反键电子数再除二，它概括简单情形的净稳定，但不能代替完整能量计算。未成对电子意味着顺磁性，可区分分子轨道预测与过度简化路易斯图，如氧气。σ 轨道绕键轴对称，π 轨道有包含键轴的节点平面。轨道图是模型而非照片，其能量顺序依原子种类变化，不能把一张排序无差别套给所有分子。

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.

body.en: A spectral wavelength changes from 400 to 600 nm. Find redshift z = (λobs − λemit)/λemit. Apply the relation step by step: z = (600 − 400)/400 = 0.5. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 谱线波长从 400 nm 变为 600 nm，红移 z 是多少？逐步代入关系：z = (600 − 400)/400 = 0.5.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “One redshift measurement alone determines every cosmological parameter.” is not valid. Several independent observations test an expansion model. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “一次红移测量就能确定全部宇宙学参数。”并不成立。多种独立观测共同检验宇宙膨胀模型。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.

body.en: Temperature orders thermal equilibrium: bodies at the same temperature exchange no net heat when thermally connected. Thermal expansion is a material response, not the definition of temperature.
body.zh: 温度表征热平衡：同温物体热接触时没有净热传递。热膨胀是材料响应，而不是温度本身的定义。

body.en: Kelvin temperature is Celsius temperature plus 273.15. Thus 0 °C is 273.15 K.
body.zh: 开尔文温度等于摄氏温度加 273.15，因此 0 °C 为 273.15 K。

body.en: The statement “Equal temperature means equal internal energy.” is not valid. Equal temperature does not require equal internal energy. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “同温意味着内能相等。”并不成立。同温不要求内能相等。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: A cyclic heat engine converts part of heat input into work and rejects the rest. A refrigerator uses work to move heat from cold to hot. During an equilibrium phase change, heat can change phase fraction without changing temperature.
body.zh: 循环热机把部分输入热转为功，其余排出。制冷机消耗功把热从低温处搬到高温处。平衡相变时，热可以改变相比例而不改变温度。

body.en: Receiving 100 J and rejecting 60 J gives 40 J of work and efficiency 0.40.
body.zh: 吸热 100 J、放热 60 J，做功 40 J，效率为 0.40。

body.en: The statement “Every heat engine can convert all heat input into work.” is not valid. A cyclic engine must reject heat when operating between finite-temperature reservoirs. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “所有热机都能把全部输入热转化为功。”并不成立。在有限温度热库间工作的循环热机必须向外放热。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Before applying the relation to a new situation, draw the system boundary and identify what is measured, what is inferred and what is assumed constant. body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.
body.zh: 物理模型始于明确的系统与可测量的量。使用方程前，写出参考系、单位、边界条件和理想化假设。标量只有大小，矢量还具有方向。变化率描述单位时间内的改变，累积量则把区间内的贡献相加。守恒定律比较同一定义系统的不同时刻，必须计入穿过边界的转移。方程两侧必须具有相同量纲，但量纲一致并不能证明模型。应检查简单极限，并用独立证据检验预测，然后才谨慎推广。

body.en: Doubling one charge doubles force, whereas doubling distance reduces force to one quarter.
body.zh: 一个电荷加倍使力加倍，距离加倍则使力降为四分之一。

body.en: The statement “The Coulomb force always attracts.” is not valid. Opposite charges attract and like charges repel. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “库仑力总是吸引力。”并不成立。异种电荷相吸，同种电荷相斥。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Charge conservation makes incoming and outgoing steady currents balance at a junction. Energy accounting makes signed voltage changes sum to zero around a lumped circuit loop without unaccounted changing magnetic flux.
body.zh: 电荷守恒要求稳态节点流入与流出电流平衡。无未计入时变磁通的集中参数电路中，绕闭合回路的带符号电压变化总和为零。

body.en: Lenz’s law selects an induced-current direction whose magnetic effect opposes the change that caused it. The opposition accounts for mechanical work becoming electrical energy and heat.
body.zh: 楞次定律确定感应电流方向：其磁效应反抗引发感应的磁通变化。这种反抗解释机械功如何转为电能与热。

body.en: Energy and momentum provide complementary descriptions of motion. Kinetic energy is a scalar, mv²/2 for a nonrelativistic particle, while momentum is the vector mv. External work changes kinetic energy; external impulse changes total momentum. Choose a system before deciding which interactions are internal. Internal forces may redistribute energy or momentum without changing an isolated system’s total momentum. Mechanical energy is conserved only when nonconservative transfers are absent or explicitly included. Keep rotational and translational motion distinct, and always specify the axis for angular quantities.

body.en: Energy and momentum provide complementary descriptions of motion. Kinetic energy is a scalar, mv²/2 for a nonrelativistic particle, while momentum is the vector mv. External work changes kinetic energy; external impulse changes total momentum. Choose a system before deciding which interactions are internal. Internal forces may redistribute energy or momentum without changing an isolated system’s total momentum. Mechanical energy is conserved only when nonconservative transfers are absent or explicitly included. Keep rotational and translational motion distinct, and always specify the axis for angular quantities.

title.zh: 冲量 · 动量守恒 · 弹性程度

body.en: Impulse is force integrated over time, or average force times duration. In an isolated collision total momentum is conserved; kinetic energy is also conserved only for an elastic collision. Sticking collisions are perfectly inelastic.
body.zh: 冲量是力对时间的积分，也可用平均力乘作用时间。孤立碰撞中总动量守恒；只有弹性碰撞还保持总动能不变。碰后粘在一起的碰撞称完全非弹性碰撞。

body.en: A force law together with an equation of motion predicts a system’s evolution. In gravity the inverse-square dependence concerns distance from the attracting mass centre. In fluids, pressure is normal force per unit area and depends on depth at rest. For oscillations, displacement is measured from equilibrium and a restoring effect points back toward that equilibrium. Density is mass divided by volume, while frequency counts cycles per second. Distinguish equilibrium, steady flow and periodic motion: each has different simplifying assumptions and different conserved quantities.
body.zh: 力的规律与运动方程共同决定系统演化。引力的平方反比关系使用到吸引质量中心的距离。流体中的压强是单位面积法向力，静止时随深度改变。振动位移从平衡位置量起，回复作用指向平衡位置。密度是质量除以体积，频率是每秒周期数。要区分平衡、稳定流动与周期运动，因为它们的简化假设和守恒量不同。

body.en: Newtonian gravity has magnitude GMm/r². For a circular orbit it supplies mv²/r, giving v² = GM/r. Gravitational potential energy referenced to infinity is −GMm/r.
body.zh: 牛顿引力大小为 GMm/r²。圆轨道中它提供 mv²/r，因此 v² = GM/r。以无穷远为零点时，引力势能为 −GMm/r。

body.en: Doubling orbital radius reduces gravitational force to one quarter, not one half.
body.zh: 轨道半径加倍时，引力减至四分之一，而不是一半。

body.en: The statement “Orbiting bodies experience no gravity.” is not valid. An orbit is continuous free fall with sufficient sideways motion. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

body.en: A force law together with an equation of motion predicts a system’s evolution. In gravity the inverse-square dependence concerns distance from the attracting mass centre. In fluids, pressure is normal force per unit area and depends on depth at rest. For oscillations, displacement is measured from equilibrium and a restoring effect points back toward that equilibrium. Density is mass divided by volume, while frequency counts cycles per second. Distinguish equilibrium, steady flow and periodic motion: each has different simplifying assumptions and different conserved quantities.
body.zh: 力的规律与运动方程共同决定系统演化。引力的平方反比关系使用到吸引质量中心的距离。流体中的压强是单位面积法向力，静止时随深度改变。振动位移从平衡位置量起，回复作用指向平衡位置。密度是质量除以体积，频率是每秒周期数。要区分平衡、稳定流动与周期运动，因为它们的简化假设和守恒量不同。

title.en: Hydrostatic pressure · Buoyant force · Displaced volume

body.en: In a constant-density fluid, pressure rises by ρgh with depth. A submerged body experiences buoyancy equal to the weight of displaced fluid. Floating equilibrium therefore equates displaced fluid weight and body weight.
body.zh: 恒定密度流体中，压强随深度增加 ρgh。浸入物体的浮力等于所排开流体的重量。漂浮平衡时，排开流体的重量等于物体重量。

body.en: A displaced volume of 0.002 m³ of water has mass 2 kg and buoyancy 20 N if g = 10 m/s².
body.zh: 排开 0.002 m³ 水，相应质量为 2 kg；取 g = 10 m/s²，浮力为 20 N。

body.en: The statement “Buoyancy always equals the object’s weight.” is not valid. Buoyancy depends on displaced fluid volume and density. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “浮力总等于物体重力。”并不成立。浮力取决于排开流体的体积和密度。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Damping transfers oscillation energy into other forms. A periodic driving force can replace that loss. body.zh: 阻尼把振动能转移为其他形式。周期驱动力可补充损失。稳态响应依赖驱动频率；弱阻尼系统在固有频率附近响应较大。阻尼增大通常使共振峰降低并变宽。

body.en: Coupled oscillators exchange energy through their interaction. A normal mode is a collective pattern in which all coordinates oscillate at one frequency with fixed amplitude ratios. Linear systems permit a general motion to be decomposed into such modes.
body.zh: 耦合振子通过相互作用交换能量。简正模是一种集体运动模式：各坐标以同一频率振动，振幅比固定。线性系统的一般运动可以分解为这些模式的叠加。

body.en: Two identical masses connected symmetrically can move together or oppositely. The coupling spring stretches differently in the two patterns, so their frequencies differ.
body.zh: 对称连接的两个相同质量可以同相或反相运动。两种模式使耦合弹簧伸长不同，因此频率不同。

body.en: Mechanics describes how positions change and why changes of velocity occur. Choose a system, an origin, a positive direction and a clock before writing equations. A particle model ignores size and rotation when these do not affect the question. A vector carries direction as well as magnitude; its components are signed numbers along chosen axes. Mass measures inertia in kilograms. Force is an interaction measured in newtons, where one newton equals one kilogram metre per second squared. Equations describe these quantities, not merely numbers.

title.en: Position and displacement · Velocity and acceleration · Constant-acceleration conditions
title.zh: 位置与位移 · 速度与加速度 · 匀加速条件

body.en: Displacement is final position minus initial position. Average velocity divides displacement by elapsed time; average speed instead uses total path length. Acceleration is velocity change per time. When acceleration is constant, v = u + at and displacement s = ut + at²/2. The signs must refer to the same axis throughout.
body.zh: 位移等于末位置减初位置。平均速度用位移除以时间；平均速率则使用总路程。加速度是速度随时间的变化。加速度恒定时，v = u + at，位移 s = ut + at²/2。所有正负号必须始终对应同一坐标轴。

body.en: Starting from rest with a = 2 m/s² for 3 s gives v = 6 m/s and s = 9 m. The velocity–time graph is a straight line; its triangular area is also 9 m.
body.zh: 从静止开始，以 2 m/s² 加速 3 s，末速度为 6 m/s，位移为 9 m。速度—时间图像是一条直线，其下三角形面积同样为 9 m。

body.en: Negative acceleration need not mean slowing down: negative velocity becoming more negative increases speed. The constant-acceleration equations fail when acceleration varies.
body.zh: 负加速度不一定表示减速：负速度变得更负时，速率反而增加。加速度变化时不能直接套用匀加速公式。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.

title.zh: 矢量分量 · 抛体运动 · 各轴独立

body.en: Resolve position, velocity and acceleration along perpendicular axes. Without air resistance near Earth, a projectile has constant horizontal velocity and downward acceleration g. Horizontal and vertical motions share the same time, which links their equations. In three dimensions a third independent component is added; vector magnitude uses the square root of the sum of squared components.
body.zh: 把位置、速度和加速度分解到互相垂直的坐标轴。近地面忽略空气阻力时，抛体水平速度恒定，竖直加速度为向下的 g。两个方向共用同一个时间，由此联系方程。三维情形增加第三个分量；矢量大小等于各分量平方和的平方根。

body.en: A horizontal launch at 8 m/s falls for 2 s, travelling 16 m horizontally. With g = 10 m/s² it drops 20 m. Combining displacements gives a diagonal displacement, not the curved path length.
body.zh: 水平以 8 m/s 抛出，飞行 2 s 后水平前进 16 m。取 g = 10 m/s²，下降 20 m。分位移合成得到斜向总位移，而不是弯曲轨迹的路程。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical positions are independent equations, but the elapsed time is shared. Air resistance would couple motion through the velocity-dependent force.
body.zh: 水平与竖直位置分别列式，但时间相同。若考虑空气阻力，依赖速度的阻力会使运动分量发生耦合。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.

title.zh: 惯性 · 合力 · 作用力与反作用力

body.en: In an inertial frame, zero net force means constant velocity. Newton’s second law is the vector equation ΣF = ma for constant mass. Draw only forces acting on the chosen body. Newton’s third law pairs equal opposite forces on different bodies; these do not cancel within a single body’s force diagram.
body.zh: 在惯性系中，合力为零意味着速度恒定。质量恒定时，牛顿第二定律为矢量方程 ΣF = ma。受力图只画作用在所选物体上的力。第三定律的一对等大反向力作用在不同物体上，不会在单个物体的受力图中互相抵消。

body.en: A 2 kg cart pulled right with 7 N and left with 3 N has net force 4 N right, hence acceleration 2 m/s² right. Its current velocity may nevertheless point left.
body.zh: 2 kg 小车受到向右 7 N、向左 3 N 的力，合力为向右 4 N，因此加速度向右，为 2 m/s²；此时速度仍可能向左。

body.en: A force changes velocity, not necessarily position in its own direction immediately. Weight and normal force are not a third-law pair because both act on one body.
body.zh: 力改变速度，并不保证物体立即沿力的方向运动。重力与支持力都作用在同一物体上，因此不是第三定律力对。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.

title.en: Normal force · Static friction · Kinetic friction
title.zh: 支持力 · 静摩擦 · 滑动摩擦

body.en: A normal force is perpendicular to a contact surface. Static friction adjusts to prevent relative slipping up to |f| ≤ μsN; it is not always at that limit. In a simple dry-contact model, sliding friction has magnitude μkN and opposes relative sliding. Surface geometry and other forces determine N.
body.zh: 支持力垂直于接触面。静摩擦力会调整大小以阻止相对滑动，但满足 |f| ≤ μsN，并非总等于最大值。简单干摩擦模型中，滑动摩擦力大小为 μkN，方向与相对滑动相反。支持力 N 由表面几何和其他力共同决定。

body.en: A horizontal 10 N push on a stationary box is balanced by 10 N static friction if the maximum is 15 N. A 20 N push exceeds that limit and slipping begins in this idealized model.
body.zh: 若最大静摩擦力为 15 N，水平推力 10 N 会被 10 N 静摩擦力平衡。若推力增为 20 N，则超过极限，在此理想模型中开始滑动。

body.en: Friction opposes relative slipping or its tendency, not necessarily the centre-of-mass velocity. A driven wheel can receive forward static friction.
body.zh: 摩擦力阻碍相对滑动或滑动趋势，不一定与质心速度相反。主动轮可以受到向前的静摩擦力。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.

title.en: Centripetal acceleration · Radial force balance · Constraint forces
title.zh: 向心加速度 · 径向受力平衡 · 约束力

body.en: Uniform circular motion changes direction even when speed is constant. The inward acceleration is v²/r. “Centripetal force” names the inward resultant, not an additional interaction: tension, gravity or contact forces can supply it. A rope constrains length only while taut, and a track can push only where contact persists.
body.zh: 匀速圆周运动虽速率恒定，方向却持续变化，向内加速度为 v²/r。“向心力”是径向合力的名称，不是额外的一种相互作用；绳力、重力或接触力都可以提供它。绳只有绷紧时才能约束长度，轨道只有保持接触时才能施加推力。

body.en: For a 1 kg object moving at 4 m/s around a radius of 2 m, the inward resultant is 8 N. If speed doubles at fixed radius, the required force becomes four times larger.
body.zh: 1 kg 物体以 4 m/s 绕半径 2 m 的圆运动，向内合力为 8 N。半径不变而速率加倍时，所需向心力增为四倍。

body.en: Do not add an extra centripetal force to the real forces. Check positive tension or normal force; a negative result means the assumed constraint has failed.
body.zh: 不要在真实作用力之外再添加一个向心力。必须检查张力或支持力非负；算得负值说明原先假定的约束无法维持。
