sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: Sequence DP summarizes a prefix or a position together with any history relevant to future decisions.
summary.zh: 序列DP汇总前缀或位置及未来所需历史。

objectives.en: Explain prefix state with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明前缀状态及其条件。

objectives.en: Use dependency order in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用依赖顺序。

body.en: Sequence DP summarizes a prefix or a position together with any history relevant to future decisions. For the longest increasing subsequence, let dp[i] be the longest strictly increasing subsequence ending exactly at i. The ending condition matters: a best subsequence somewhere in the prefix may end with a value too large to extend.
body.zh: 序列DP汇总前缀或位置及未来所需历史。最长严格上升子序列定义dp[i]为恰好以i结尾的最优长度；“以i结尾”重要，因为前缀最优可能以过大元素结尾而不能延伸。

body.en: The recurrence is dp[i]=1+max dp[j] over j<i with a[j]<a[i], using zero when no predecessor qualifies. Testing every earlier j gives O(n²) time and O(n) space. Grid DP similarly uses topological movement: if moves are only right or down, a cell can depend on its upper and left neighbors.
body.zh: 递推为dp[i]=1+max dp[j]，限制j<i且a[j]<a[i]，没有前驱时最大值取0。枚举前驱为O(n²)时间、O(n)空间。网格若只能右或下，可依赖上方和左方。

body.en: For [3,1,2,5], the ending lengths are [1,1,2,3], and the answer is three from 1,2,5. On a 2-by-3 obstacle-free grid, starting at the upper-left and moving right/down yields three paths to the lower-right. Initialize the start to one; blocked cells contribute zero regardless of their neighbors.
body.zh: [3,1,2,5]的结尾长度为[1,1,2,3]，答案是1、2、5。无障碍2行3列网格从左上到右下有三条右下路径；起点置1，障碍格无论邻居如何都置0。

body.en: Rolling arrays discard a row only after no future transition needs it. Updating left-to-right may intentionally reuse the current row’s left value while retaining the old upper value. For reconstruction, store predecessor choices or recompute them later. Strictly increasing and nondecreasing subsequences use different comparisons, so duplicate-value tests are essential.
body.zh: 滚动数组只能在未来不再需要旧行时覆盖。由左至右更新时可有意使用当前行左值和旧行上值。重建路径要存前驱或重算；严格上升和不下降比较条件不同，必须测重复值。

prompt.en: What is the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence in [3,1,2,5]?
prompt.zh: [3,1,2,5]最长严格上升子序列长度是多少？

explanation.en: These three increase; all four do not because 3 precedes 1.
explanation.zh: 这三项递增，四项不行因为3在1之前。

prompt.en: A blocked grid cell may retain the sum of its incoming path counts.
prompt.zh: 障碍格可以保留到达它的路径数之和。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: No legal path passes through it.
hints.zh: 合法路径不能经过障碍。

explanation.en: Its state must be zero so it contributes no outgoing paths.
explanation.zh: 其状态必须为0，不能贡献后续路径。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: In zero-one knapsack, each item has a weight and value and may be taken at most once.
summary.zh: 零一背包每项有重量和价值，至多取一次，求容量W内最大总价值。

objectives.en: Explain capacity state with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明容量状态及其条件。

objectives.en: Use zero-one choice in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用零一选择。

body.en: In zero-one knapsack, each item has a weight and value and may be taken at most once. The goal is maximum total value within capacity W. Define dp[i][c] as the best value using the first i items with capacity at most c. Including the item is possible only when its weight fits.
body.zh: 零一背包每项有重量和价值，至多取一次，求容量W内最大总价值。dp[i][c]表示前i项、容量不超过c的最优值；重量放得下时才可选当前项。

body.en: For weight w and value v, compare skipping with taking: dp[i][c]=max(dp[i−1][c],dp[i−1][c−w]+v). Compressing away i requires iterating capacities downward, preserving the previous row’s smaller-capacity values. Upward iteration instead permits reusing the current item and solves the unbounded variant when that reuse is intended.
body.zh: 递推比较不选与选：dp[i][c]=max(dp[i−1][c],dp[i−1][c−w]+v)。压掉i后必须倒序容量以保持上一行；正序会复用当前物品，在允许无限件时才正确。

body.en: With items (weight 2,value 3) and (weight 3,value 4), capacity five admits both, value seven. Capacity four admits only one of them, best value four. If the weight-two item is processed upward, capacity four could incorrectly reuse it twice and claim value six in the zero-one problem.
body.zh: 物品(重2值3)、(重3值4)，容量5可都取，总值7；容量4只能取一个，最优4。若重2物品正序更新，容量4可能错误复用两次，得到6。

body.en: An at-most-capacity state often starts at zero because choosing nothing is valid. An exact-weight state instead sets unreachable weights to negative infinity and only weight zero to zero. Complexity O(nW) is pseudo-polynomial: W is a numeric magnitude, not its binary encoding length. Large capacities may favor value-based DP, sparse states, or meet-in-the-middle.
body.zh: 不超过容量时，空选择合法，可初始化为0。恰好重量时，只有重量0为0，其他不可达置负无穷。O(nW)为伪多项式，因为W是数值而非二进制位数；大容量可用价值DP、稀疏状态或折半。

prompt.en: For items (2,3),(3,4) with capacity 5, what is the best zero-one value?
prompt.zh: 物品(重量,价值)为(2,3)、(3,4)，容量5最优值是多少？

hints.en: Both weights fit together.
hints.zh: 两件重量之和正好能装下。

explanation.en: Weights sum to 5 and values to 7.
explanation.zh: 重量和5，价值和7。

prompt.en: One-dimensional zero-one knapsack normally updates capacities upward.
prompt.zh: 一维零一背包通常正序更新容量。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: Prevent using the same item twice.
hints.zh: 需要防止同件重复使用。

explanation.en: Descending updates retain the preceding item layer for every source state.
explanation.zh: 倒序更新使每个来源仍属于上一物品层。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: DP applies whenever dependencies form an acyclic graph of states.
summary.zh: 只要状态依赖无环，就可按序DP。

objectives.en: Explain interval state with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明区间状态及其条件。

objectives.en: Use subtree state in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用子树状态。

body.en: DP applies whenever dependencies form an acyclic graph of states. Interval states describe contiguous subranges; tree states describe subtrees; DAG states follow a topological order. The visible input need not be a sequence. What matters is that every source state is available before the transition that consumes it.
body.zh: 只要状态依赖无环，就可按序DP。区间状态描述连续子段，树状态描述子树，DAG状态按拓扑序计算。输入不必是序列，关键是使用状态前其来源已算好。

body.en: For matrix-chain multiplication, dp[l][r] is the cheapest way to multiply matrices l through r. Split after k, combine the two optimal subchains, and add the scalar cost determined by the endpoint dimensions. Iterate increasing interval lengths so both shorter subintervals are ready. Trying every split gives cubic time in the number of matrices.
body.zh: 矩阵连乘dp[l][r]表示乘完l到r最少代价。枚举断点k，合并左右最优子链，再加由端点维度决定的乘法成本。按区间长度递增计算，枚举断点使总时间立方级。

body.en: For matrices of dimensions 10×30, 30×5, and 5×60, multiplying the first pair costs 1500, then the result by the third costs 3000, total 4500. Multiplying the last pair first costs 9000 then 18000, total 27000. Associativity preserves the mathematical result but not computational cost.
body.zh: 维度10×30、30×5、5×60，先乘前两项代价1500，再乘第三项3000，共4500；先后两项则9000加18000，共27000。结合律保持结果，却不保持计算量。

body.en: Tree DP often uses postorder traversal so children are solved before parents. For a maximum-weight independent set, store separate values for selecting or excluding each vertex; selecting it forces every child excluded. A graph with cycles needs another state formulation or structural decomposition, since naive recursive dependence can loop forever.
body.zh: 树DP常后序处理，先孩子后父亲。最大权独立集保存选与不选节点两种状态；选父亲就强制孩子不选。含环图需要其他状态或结构分解，否则递归依赖可能永远循环。

prompt.en: For the three matrix dimensions in the example, what is the better multiplication cost?
prompt.zh: 例题三矩阵较优连乘成本是多少？

hints.en: Compare the two parenthesizations.
hints.zh: 比较两种括号方案。

prompt.en: A topological DP order requires all dependency cycles to be handled or removed.
prompt.zh: 拓扑DP要求处理或消除所有依赖环。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: A cycle has no first state.
hints.zh: 环中没有可先求的状态。

explanation.en: Without additional mathematics, cyclic states cannot all wait for one another.
explanation.zh: 没有额外数学方法时，循环状态不能彼此等待。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

title.zh: 状压、数位与计数动态规划

summary.en: A bitmask stores a subset of a small universe: bit j records whether item j is present.
summary.zh: 位掩码用第j位表示元素j是否在子集中。

objectives.en: Explain subset mask with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明子集位掩码及其条件。

objectives.en: Use tight prefix in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用受限前缀。

body.en: A bitmask stores a subset of a small universe: bit j records whether item j is present. Subset DP may additionally store an endpoint, as in shortest Hamiltonian paths. The number of masks is 2^n, so the method exploits small n rather than removing exponential complexity. Transitions must preserve the exact meaning of each state.
body.zh: 位掩码用第j位表示元素j是否在子集中。子集DP可额外记录终点，如最短哈密顿路径。掩码数为2^n，因此依赖n较小，而不是消除指数复杂度。转移必须保持状态含义。

body.en: Digit DP counts integers bounded by a given digit string. A state tracks digit position, whether the chosen prefix still equals the bound, and relevant properties such as digit sum. A tight prefix restricts the next digit to the bound’s digit; a smaller prefix permits every digit. Leading zeros may require a separate started flag.
body.zh: 数位DP计数不超过给定数字串的整数，状态记录位置、前缀是否仍等于上界及数字和等性质。贴住上界时下一位受限制，已较小时可任选。前导零有时需要started标志。

body.en: To count two-bit strings with exactly one set bit, start count[0][0]=1. Each position adds either zero or one to the set-bit count. After two positions, counts for zero, one, and two ones are 1,2,1. The middle value counts two distinct strings, 01 and 10, even though they share a summary state.
body.zh: 数两位二进制串恰有一个1，初始count[0][0]=1，每位选择0或1。两位后，含0、1、2个1的数量为1、2、1；中间2代表01与10，虽汇总状态相同仍是不同方案。

body.en: Counting recurrences add mutually exclusive cases. If the same construction reaches a state through multiple descriptions, the sum overcounts. Decide whether leading-zero representations describe the same integer and whether the integer zero is included. Modular arithmetic prevents huge integer growth only when the question asks for a residue; it does not preserve probabilities or ordering automatically.
body.zh: 计数递推应相加互斥情况；同一对象多种描述会重计。明确前导零是否表示同一整数及是否包括零。模运算仅在要求余数时控制数值增长，不会自动保持概率和大小关系。

prompt.en: How many three-bit strings contain exactly two ones?
prompt.zh: 三位二进制串恰有两个1的有多少？

hints.en: Choose the position of the zero.
hints.zh: 选择唯一0的位置。

explanation.en: 011,101,110 give three strings.

prompt.en: Merging states means that distinct counted constructions should lose their multiplicities.
prompt.zh: 合并状态意味着不同构造的数量可以丢失。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: The state summarizes properties, while its value records the count.
hints.zh: 状态汇总性质，数值记录数量。

explanation.en: Compatible histories add their counts rather than becoming one history.
explanation.zh: 兼容历史应相加计数，而不是变成一种历史。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: After obtaining a DP value, reconstruction recovers an actual sequence of decisions attaining it.
summary.zh: 求出DP值后，重建恢复达到它的决策序列。

objectives.en: Explain predecessor choice with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明前驱选择及其条件。

objectives.en: Use monotone queue in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用单调队列。

body.en: After obtaining a DP value, reconstruction recovers an actual sequence of decisions attaining it. Store a predecessor whenever a transition improves the state. Begin at the final state and follow predecessors backward, then reverse the resulting sequence if necessary. Specify a tie rule when multiple optimal solutions are permitted.
body.zh: 求出DP值后，重建恢复达到它的决策序列。转移改善时保存前驱，从终态反向追踪，必要时翻转序列。多个最优方案都允许时，也应规定一致的平局规则。

body.en: Optimization reduces transition work only when additional structure is proved. For dp[i]=a[i]+min dp[j] over a sliding window, maintain candidate indices in a deque with increasing values. Remove expired indices from the front and dominated candidates from the back. Each index enters and leaves at most once, giving linear total deque work.
body.zh: 优化需要额外结构证明。若dp[i]=a[i]+滑动窗口内min dp[j]，可用按值递增的双端队列保存下标；从前端删过期项，从后端删被支配项。每项各进出一次，总工作线性。

body.en: For values [5,2,4,1] and a window of length three, the first minimum is two and the second is one. When one arrives, older larger candidates cannot become the minimum before they expire, so they are discarded. Retaining indices instead of values is necessary to know when an equal-valued candidate leaves the window.
body.zh: [5,2,4,1]长三窗口最小值依次为2和1。1到来后，较老较大候选到过期前都不可能最小，可舍弃。必须保存下标而不只是值，才能判断相等候选何时离开窗口。

body.en: Rolling memory can destroy the predecessor information needed for reconstruction. Preserve decisions, checkpoint layers, or recompute subproblems with an explicit time-space trade-off. Convex-hull and divide-and-conquer DP optimizations have stronger algebraic or monotonicity assumptions; an observed pattern on random examples does not establish those assumptions for every legal input.
body.zh: 滚动内存可能破坏重建所需前驱；可存决策、检查点或重算子问题，并明确时间空间权衡。凸包与分治DP优化需要更强代数或单调性条件，随机样例中的规律不等于普遍证明。

prompt.en: What is the minimum of the final length-three window in [5,2,4,1]?
prompt.zh: [5,2,4,1]最后一个长三窗口最小值是多少？

hints.en: The final window is [2,4,1].

explanation.en: Its minimum is one.
explanation.zh: 其最小值为1。

prompt.en: A rolling value array always preserves enough information to reconstruct an optimal path.
prompt.zh: 滚动值数组总能保留足够信息重建最优路径。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: Past decisions may have been overwritten.
hints.zh: 过去决策可能已覆盖。

explanation.en: Reconstruction needs saved predecessors or a planned recomputation method.
explanation.zh: 重建需要保存前驱或设计重算方法。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: A graph consists of vertices and edges.
summary.zh: 图由顶点和边组成。

objectives.en: Explain adjacency list with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明邻接表及其条件。

objectives.en: Use dfs and bfs in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用深搜与广搜。

body.en: A graph consists of vertices and edges. Vertices represent objects; edges represent a chosen relationship. Cities and roads form one example, lessons and prerequisites another. An edge may be directed when the relationship has an order. A prerequisite arrow from A to B means A is required before B, not that B is required before A.
body.zh: 图由顶点和边组成。顶点表示对象，边表示选定的关系，例如城市与道路、课程与先修知识。有顺序的关系需要有向边。先修箭头 A→B 表示 B 需要 A，并不表示 A 也需要 B。

body.en: A path follows edges from one vertex to another, respecting directions when present. A vertex is reachable if such a sequence exists. A cycle returns to its starting vertex. Required-knowledge relationships should not form a cycle, or every item in the cycle would demand another before anyone can begin.
body.zh: 路径沿着边从一个顶点到另一个顶点；有方向时必须遵守方向。存在这样的序列就称为可达。环会回到起点。必要先修关系不应形成环，否则环中每项都要求先学另一项，无法开始。

body.en: Let arithmetic → equations, equations → functions, and functions → derivatives. Arithmetic is an indirect prerequisite of derivatives even without a direct edge. If vectors is a separate root, it need not precede these particular lessons unless an explicit dependency is added. Connections should explain actual assumptions, not just topical similarity.
body.zh: 设算术→方程、方程→函数、函数→导数。即使没有直接边，算术也是导数的间接先修。如果向量是独立根节点，就不能仅因主题相关而要求先学向量。依赖必须反映实际前提，而不是话题相似。

body.en: Moving a vertex on screen does not change the graph. Crossing drawn edges do not create a vertex unless one is specified. Distinguish a required edge from a related-topic link; the latter may form cycles without making the prerequisite system inconsistent.
body.zh: 移动屏幕上的顶点不会改变图。两条线在图上交叉，也不会自动产生新顶点。必须区分必要依赖和相关话题链接；后者可以形成环，而不破坏先修系统的一致性。

prompt.en: In A→B→C→D, how many edges are followed from A to D?
prompt.zh: 在 A→B→C→D 中，从 A 到 D 经过几条边？

hints.en: Count connections, not vertices.
hints.zh: 数连接，不是数顶点。

explanation.en: The path uses A→B, B→C, and C→D: three edges.
explanation.zh: 路径使用 A→B、B→C、C→D，共三条边。

prompt.en: Which is a prerequisite cycle?
prompt.zh: 哪个构成先修环？

text.en: A→B and B→C
text.zh: A→B，B→C

text.en: A→B and B→A
text.zh: A→B，B→A

text.en: A→B and A→C
text.zh: A→B，A→C

hints.en: Can following arrows return to the start?
hints.zh: 沿箭头能否回到起点？

explanation.en: A→B→A returns to A and demands each lesson before the other.
explanation.zh: A→B→A 回到 A，导致两门课互相要求先学对方。

title.zh: 拓扑序与有向无环图推理

summary.en: A directed acyclic graph has no directed cycle.
summary.zh: 有向无环图没有有向环。

objectives.en: Explain indegree with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明入度及其条件。

objectives.en: Use topological order in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用拓扑序。

body.en: A directed acyclic graph has no directed cycle. A topological order lists vertices so every edge points from an earlier vertex to a later one. It represents legal scheduling when an edge means one task must precede another. More than one order can satisfy the same dependency graph; the graph need not define a total order.
body.zh: 有向无环图没有有向环。拓扑序使每条边从较早顶点指向较晚顶点，可表示任务先后约束。相同依赖图可以有多种合法拓扑序，不必确定唯一总顺序。

body.en: Kahn’s algorithm repeatedly removes a vertex of indegree zero and decrements the indegrees of its outgoing neighbors. A removed vertex has no remaining prerequisite, so appending it is safe. If vertices remain but none has indegree zero, following remaining incoming edges must eventually revisit a vertex, proving a directed cycle.
body.zh: Kahn算法反复取入度0顶点，删除它并降低出边邻居入度。它已无剩余前提，可安全加入序列。如果仍有顶点却无入度0者，沿入边追踪必重访顶点，证明存在环。

body.en: For edges A→C, B→C, C→D, both A and B initially have indegree zero. Either A,B,C,D or B,A,C,D is valid. The longest prerequisite chain to D has three vertices. A DP can compute completion times by taking the maximum predecessor completion plus the current task duration.
body.zh: 边A→C、B→C、C→D中，A和B初始入度0，A,B,C,D与B,A,C,D都合法。到D最长依赖链有三顶点；可用前驱最晚完成时间加当前工期计算完成时间。

body.en: A BFS discovery order is not generally a topological order because a vertex may be discovered before another prerequisite is processed. Detect failure explicitly rather than silently outputting a partial schedule. Topological shortest-path and longest-path recurrences work with negative edge weights because acyclic dependencies prevent repeated relaxation cycles.
body.zh: BFS发现序不一定是拓扑序，发现节点时其他前提可能尚未处理。必须显式报告环，不能悄悄输出部分安排。DAG最短路或最长路可处理负边，因为无环避免反复松弛依赖。

prompt.en: In A→C, B→C, C→D, what is the initial indegree of C?
prompt.zh: A→C、B→C、C→D中，C初始入度是多少？

hints.en: Count incoming arrows.
hints.zh: 数指向C的箭头。

explanation.en: A and B each contribute one incoming edge.
explanation.zh: A、B各贡献一条入边。

prompt.en: Every directed graph has a topological order.
prompt.zh: 所有有向图都有拓扑序。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: A cycle would require each vertex to precede itself.
hints.zh: 环会要求顶点间接先于自己。

explanation.en: Exactly directed acyclic graphs admit such an ordering.
explanation.zh: 恰好有向无环图才存在拓扑序。

summary.en: A path cost is the sum of its edge weights.
summary.zh: 路径代价是边权和。

objectives.en: Explain relaxation with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明松弛及其条件。

objectives.en: Use settled distance in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用已确定距离。

body.en: A path cost is the sum of its edge weights. Relaxing edge u→v means replacing d[v] by min(d[v],d[u]+w) when u is reachable. Distances begin at infinity except the source, which starts at zero. Infinity is a sentinel and must not be blindly added to a weight in fixed-width arithmetic.
body.zh: 路径代价是边权和。松弛u→v就是在u可达时令d[v]=min(d[v],d[u]+w)。除源点为0外初始化无穷；无穷是标记，固定宽度运算中不能盲目与权值相加。

body.en: BFS handles equal unit weights. Dijkstra repeatedly settles the smallest tentative distance; nonnegative weights ensure no later route can improve that settled vertex. Bellman–Ford relaxes every edge repeatedly and supports negative edges. An improvement after n−1 full rounds identifies a reachable negative cycle or its downstream effect, where finite shortest-walk values may fail to exist.
body.zh: 单位权用BFS。Dijkstra每次确定最小暂定距离，非负权保证以后无法改善它。Bellman–Ford反复松弛全部边，支持负边；n−1轮后仍改善说明可达负环或其影响，此时部分最短游走无有限值。

body.en: For edges A→B of weight four, A→C of weight one, and C→B of weight two, initialize B=4 and C=1. Settling C relaxes B to three. Settling B then finalizes that distance. The direct edge is not always the shortest route; the route through C costs 1+2=3.
body.zh: A→B权4，A→C权1，C→B权2，先得B=4、C=1。确定C后把B松弛到3，再确定B。直达边不一定最短，经C成本1+2=3。

body.en: With a binary heap and adjacency lists, Dijkstra runs in O((n+m) log n) using a standard implementation. Heap entries may become stale; compare the popped distance with the current stored one. Store predecessors to recover paths, and distinguish unreachable vertices from vertices affected by a reachable negative cycle. These are different mathematical outcomes.
body.zh: 邻接表配二叉堆的Dijkstra通常O((n+m)log n)。堆条目可能过期，弹出时检查是否等于当前距离。保存前驱可恢复路径；不可达与受可达负环影响是不同数学结果。

prompt.en: In the example, what is the shortest distance from A to B?
prompt.zh: 例题A到B最短距离是多少？

hints.en: Compare the direct edge with A→C→B.
hints.zh: 比较直达与经C路径。

prompt.zh: 普通Dijkstra对任意负边都保证正确。

text.zh: 正确

hints.zh: 确定距离的证明依赖非负权。

summary.en: A spanning tree connects every vertex of a connected undirected graph without cycles.
summary.zh: 生成树在无向连通图中无环连接全部顶点。

objectives.en: Explain spanning tree with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明生成树及其条件。

objectives.en: Use cut property in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用割性质。

body.en: A spanning tree connects every vertex of a connected undirected graph without cycles. A minimum spanning tree minimizes the total weight of its chosen edges. It solves a network-connection objective, not shortest distances from a source. Negative edge weights are allowed because the tree constraint limits the number of selected edges.
body.zh: 生成树在无向连通图中无环连接全部顶点。最小生成树最小化选边总权，解决连接网络问题，不是单源最短距离。允许负边，因为树约束限制了选边数量。

body.en: The cut property says a lightest edge crossing a cut that respects current chosen components can be added safely to some optimal tree. If an optimal tree lacks that edge, adding it creates a cycle; remove a no-lighter crossing edge on the cycle. Connectivity survives and total weight does not increase.
body.zh: 割性质：在不拆开当前已选连通块的割中，最轻跨割边可安全加入某最优树。若最优树没有它，加入后成环，删去环上另一条不更轻跨割边，保持连通且总权不增。

body.en: Kruskal sorts edges and uses DSU to add only edges joining different components. For a triangle with weights one, two, and five, it adds one and two, total three; the weight-five edge would create a cycle. Prim instead grows one connected region by repeatedly taking a cheapest edge leaving that region.
body.zh: Kruskal排序后用并查集只加入连接不同块的边。三角形权1、2、5，选1和2，总权3；权5会成环。Prim则从一个连通区域出发，反复选最便宜的出区域边。

body.en: Kruskal takes O(m log m) time dominated by sorting. A disconnected input has a minimum spanning forest rather than one spanning tree; verify the final edge count before claiming full connectivity. Equal weights may produce several different optimal trees. Uniqueness is a separate property and must not be inferred merely from obtaining one deterministic output.
body.zh: Kruskal时间O(m log m)，主要来自排序。非连通输入得到最小生成森林，声称全连通前应检查边数。相等权可能有多个最优树；算法输出确定并不证明最优树唯一。

prompt.en: What is the MST weight of a triangle whose edges weigh 1,2,5?
prompt.zh: 三角形边权1、2、5，最小生成树总权是多少？

hints.en: Choose two edges that connect all three vertices.
hints.zh: 选两条连接全部三个点的边。

explanation.en: Weights 1 and 2 suffice, totaling 3.
explanation.zh: 选1和2即连通，总权3。

prompt.en: A minimum spanning tree necessarily preserves every source-to-vertex shortest distance.
prompt.zh: 最小生成树必然保留某源点到各点的最短距离。

text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: Its objective is the sum of chosen edge weights.
hints.zh: 它优化选边总权。

explanation.en: Connecting everything cheaply differs from minimizing each individual path.
explanation.zh: 廉价连接全部点与最小化每条路径不同。

summary.en: An undirected bridge is an edge whose removal increases the number of connected components.
summary.zh: 无向桥是删除后连通分量数增加的边；割点删除后同样造成额外分离，它们描述连通脆弱性。

objectives.en: Explain bridge with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明桥及其条件。

objectives.en: Use low-link value in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用低链接值。

body.en: An undirected bridge is an edge whose removal increases the number of connected components. An articulation vertex similarly disconnects additional parts when removed. These concepts measure vulnerability of connectivity. In directed graphs, strong connectivity means that each pair can reach one another in both directions, a stricter property than weak undirected connectivity.
body.zh: 无向桥是删除后连通分量数增加的边；割点删除后同样造成额外分离，它们描述连通脆弱性。有向强连通要求每对顶点双向可达，比忽略方向的弱连通更强。

body.en: During DFS, tin[v] records discovery time and low[v] the earliest ancestor reachable from v’s subtree using tree edges plus at most one back edge. A tree edge v→child is a bridge exactly when low[child]>tin[v]. Equality means the subtree can return to v without that tree edge, so the edge lies on a cycle.
body.zh: DFS中tin[v]记录发现时间，low[v]为其子树经树边加至多一条返祖边能到达的最早祖先。树边v→child为桥当且仅当low[child]>tin[v]；等号表示可绕回v，边位于环上。

body.en: Take a triangle A-B-C-A with an extra edge C-D. Triangle edges have alternate routes and are not bridges. C-D is a bridge because D becomes isolated after removal. Vertex C is an articulation point. Contracting each strongly connected component of a directed graph produces a DAG, enabling later topological analysis.
body.zh: 三角形A-B-C-A外接C-D，三角形每边有绕路，不是桥；C-D删除后D孤立，因此是桥，C是割点。有向图把强连通分量缩点后得到DAG，可继续拓扑分析。

body.en: With parallel edges, skip the exact parent edge identifier rather than every edge leading to the parent vertex; another parallel edge is a valid alternative connection. Run DFS from every unvisited vertex on disconnected inputs. Bridge detection, articulation detection, and SCC algorithms use related timestamps but different stack and inequality rules, so their conditions are not interchangeable.
body.zh: 有重边时应跳过具体父边编号，而不是所有指向父顶点的边；另一条重边是合法绕路。非连通图要从每个未访问点出发。桥、割点、强连通虽都用时间戳，但栈与不等式条件不可混用。

prompt.en: How many bridges are in a triangle with one pendant edge attached?
prompt.zh: 一个三角形外接一条悬挂边，共有几条桥？

hints.en: Only the pendant edge lacks an alternate route.
hints.zh: 只有悬挂边无替代路线。

explanation.en: The three cycle edges are not bridges; the pendant edge is.
explanation.zh: 三条环边都不是桥，悬挂边是桥。

prompt.en: Contracting strongly connected components creates an acyclic directed graph.
prompt.zh: 把强连通分量缩点后得到有向无环图。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.zh: 分量间若有环就会彼此可达。

explanation.en: Those vertices would belong to one larger strongly connected component, contradicting maximality.
explanation.zh: 它们应属于同一更大强连通分量，与极大性矛盾。

summary.en: A flow network is a directed graph with nonnegative edge capacities, a source, and a sink.
summary.zh: 流网络是有非负容量、源点和汇点的有向图。

objectives.en: Explain capacity and conservation with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明容量与守恒及其条件。

objectives.en: Use residual edge in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用残量边。

body.en: A flow network is a directed graph with nonnegative edge capacities, a source, and a sink. Feasible flow never exceeds capacity and conserves incoming and outgoing flow at other vertices. A maximum flow sends the largest possible total amount from source to sink. Capacities model simultaneous resource limits, not travel distances.
body.zh: 流网络是有非负容量、源点和汇点的有向图。流量不超过容量，其余点满足流入等于流出。最大流把尽可能多的总量从源送到汇；容量表示同时资源限制，不是距离。

body.en: The residual graph records how the current flow can change. A forward residual edge permits extra flow; a reverse edge permits undoing previously sent flow. An augmenting path increases total flow by its smallest residual capacity. Reverse edges are essential because an early path choice may need rearrangement to reach the optimum.
body.zh: 残量图记录当前流如何改变：正向边允许增加，反向边允许撤销已送流。增广路按最小残量容量增加总流。反向边不可缺少，因为早先选路可能必须重新分配才能最优。

body.en: For bipartite matching, connect source to every left vertex with capacity one, each allowed left-right pair with capacity one, and every right vertex to sink with capacity one. An integral unit flow selects a pair. The surrounding capacity-one edges ensure that no vertex participates in more than one selected pair.
body.zh: 二分匹配可令源到左点容量1，允许配对的左右边容量1，右点到汇容量1。整数单位流选中配对；两侧容量1限制每点至多参加一个配对。

body.en: A cut separates source from sink; its capacity bounds every feasible flow because all sent flow must cross it. When no augmenting path remains, reachable vertices in the residual graph identify a cut whose capacity equals the flow. This proves optimality. For general integer capacities, naive augmentation count can depend on flow magnitude; algorithm choice matters.
body.zh: 割把源汇分开，所有流都必须跨割，所以割容量是上界。没有增广路时，残量可达点给出容量等于当前流的割，从而证明最优。整数容量下朴素增广次数可能依赖流量数值，需合理选算法。

prompt.en: A path has residual capacities 5,2,7. How much flow can be augmented along it?
prompt.zh: 残量路径容量5、2、7，一次最多增广多少？

hints.en: The narrowest edge is the bottleneck.
hints.zh: 最窄边是瓶颈。

explanation.en: Sending more than two violates the middle capacity.
explanation.zh: 超过2会违反中间边容量。

prompt.en: Residual reverse edges mean that the original network must have had reverse edges.
prompt.zh: 残量反向边意味着原网络必有反向边。

text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.zh: 它们表示撤销已有流的能力。

explanation.en: Residual reverse edges are bookkeeping operations, even when no original reverse arc exists.
explanation.zh: 即使原图无反向弧，也需要残量反向边记录撤销。

summary.en: An alphabet is a set of symbols, and a string is a finite ordered sequence of them.
summary.zh: 字母表是符号集合，字符串是其有限有序序列。

objectives.en: Explain alphabet with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明字母表及其条件。

objectives.en: Use substring in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用子串。

body.en: An alphabet is a set of symbols, and a string is a finite ordered sequence of them. A substring uses consecutive positions; a subsequence can skip positions while preserving order. Pattern matching asks which text positions begin an occurrence of the complete pattern. Decide separately whether the empty pattern is permitted.
body.zh: 字母表是符号集合，字符串是其有限有序序列。子串占连续位置，子序列可跳过位置但保持顺序。模式匹配寻找完整模式出现的文本起点；空模式是否允许需单独说明。

body.en: Naive matching tries every possible start and compares symbols until a mismatch or completion. For text length n and pattern length m≤n, there are n−m+1 starts and at most m comparisons per start. This gives O(nm) worst-case time, even though many ordinary inputs fail a comparison early.
body.zh: 朴素匹配枚举每个起点，比较直到失败或完成。文本n长、模式m≤n长时，有n−m+1个起点，每处至多m次比较，最坏O(nm)，尽管普通输入可能很早失配。

body.en: In aaaaa, pattern aaa occurs at positions 0,1,2. Advancing by three after the first occurrence misses valid overlaps. A comparison unit also matters: a UTF-8 byte is not necessarily a visible character. The number of bytes, Unicode code points, and user-perceived characters can differ for the same displayed text.
body.zh: aaaaa中aaa出现在0、1、2，第一次成功后跳三位会漏重叠。比较单位也重要，UTF-8字节未必是可见字符，同一显示文本的字节数、码点数和用户感知字符数可能不同。

body.en: State whether matching is byte-exact, normalized Unicode, or case-insensitive. These are different problems, not implementation details to change silently. Later linear-time methods reuse comparisons while keeping the matching definition fixed. Test repeated characters, a pattern longer than the text, boundary matches, and overlaps before replacing a simple oracle with a faster implementation.
body.zh: 应明确字节精确、Unicode规范化还是忽略大小写，这些是不同问题，不能悄悄改变。后续线性算法在语义不变下复用比较。优化前测试重复字符、模式更长、边界和重叠，并保留简单答案程序。

prompt.en: How many overlapping occurrences of aa occur in aaaa?
prompt.zh: aaaa中可重叠的aa有多少？

explanation.en: Three starts fit a two-symbol pattern.
explanation.zh: 三个起点均容纳两字符模式。

summary.en: A border is a proper prefix that is also a suffix.
summary.zh: 边界是同时为后缀的真前缀。

objectives.en: Explain border with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明边界及其条件。

objectives.en: Use failure link in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用失配链接。

body.en: A border is a proper prefix that is also a suffix. The prefix function pi[i] gives the longest border length of the prefix ending at i. Proper excludes the entire prefix itself. Borders identify which already matched characters remain useful after a mismatch, avoiding repeated comparisons with the same text positions.
body.zh: 边界是同时为后缀的真前缀。pi[i]给出以i结尾前缀的最长边界长度，真前缀排除整个自身。边界说明失配后哪些已匹配字符仍可利用，避免反复比较相同文本位置。

body.en: Start the next prefix computation with j=pi[i−1]. While j>0 and characters differ, replace j by pi[j−1], choosing the next shorter possible border. When characters agree, increment j. Every skipped candidate is already excluded by the border structure, so fallback does not discard a potentially valid continuation.
body.zh: 计算下一前缀先令j=pi[i−1]。j>0且字符不同就令j=pi[j−1]转到更短边界；相等则j加一。边界结构已排除所有跳过的候选，因此不漏可能延伸。

body.en: For ababa, prefix values are 0,0,1,2,3. The full pattern’s longest border is aba. After a complete match, falling back to length three preserves overlapping occurrences. KMP scans the text forward while maintaining this matched prefix length; it does not rewind the text cursor to retry each potential start.
body.zh: ababa的前缀值是0、0、1、2、3，最长边界为aba。完整匹配后退到长度三可保留重叠。KMP向前扫描文本并维护已匹配前缀长度，不回退文本游标逐起点重试。

body.en: The total time is O(n+m): the matched length increases at most once per processed symbol, and every fallback strictly decreases it. Distinguish pattern indices from text indices. After reporting a full match, follow its border before reading another pattern symbol; otherwise an access at the pattern length would be out of bounds.
body.zh: 总时间O(n+m)：每符号匹配长度至多增一，每次回退严格减少。要区分模式与文本下标；报告完整匹配后，先沿边界回退再读下一模式字符，否则会越界。

prompt.zh: ababa最长真边界长度是多少？

explanation.zh: aba长三，没有更长真前缀也是后缀。

summary.en: Z[i] is the length of the longest string prefix matching the substring starting at i.
summary.zh: Z[i]是从i开始子串与全串前缀的最长匹配长度。

objectives.en: Explain prefix match with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明前缀匹配及其条件。

objectives.en: Use z interval in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用Z区间。

body.en: Z[i] is the length of the longest string prefix matching the substring starting at i. Maintain an interval [l,r) already known to match the prefix. For a position inside that interval, previous Z values provide a safe initial match length without comparing every character again. This is structural reuse, not probabilistic guessing.
body.zh: Z[i]是从i开始子串与全串前缀的最长匹配长度。维护已知匹配前缀的[l,r)，区间内位置可用旧Z值初始化，而不重比每字。这是结构复用，不是概率猜测。

body.en: When i<r, begin with min(r−i,Z[i−l]), then compare beyond that initial match as needed. The right boundary only moves forward, bounding total extension work linearly. Pattern matching can use pattern plus a separator outside the alphabet plus text; a Z value at least the pattern length signals a match.
body.zh: i<r时从min(r−i,Z[i−l])开始，必要时继续比较。右边界只向前，总扩展量线性。对模式、字母表外分隔符、文本的拼接求Z，达到模式长度即匹配。

body.en: A rolling polynomial hash uses H=Σc[i]B^(k−1−i) modulo M. With digits 1,2,3, base ten, and modulus 101, the result is 22. Prefix hashes and precomputed powers obtain a substring hash by removing the earlier prefix’s shifted contribution, enabling fast repeated substring comparisons after preprocessing.
body.zh: 滚动多项式哈希H=Σc[i]B^(k−1−i) mod M。数字1、2、3取底10、模101，得22。前缀哈希与预计算幂可减掉先前前缀的移位贡献，预处理后快速比较子串。

body.en: Equal hashes do not prove equal strings: a finite hash range cannot encode every possible string uniquely. Several moduli or randomized bases reduce collision risk under stated assumptions. Exact results need verification or a deterministic method. Modular multiplication must avoid invalid intermediate signed overflow, even when the final reduced residue fits the chosen type.
body.zh: 哈希相等不证明串相等，有限范围无法唯一编码所有串。多模数或随机底数在条件下减少风险。精确结果需复核或确定算法；即使最终余数可表示，中间模乘也必须避免有符号溢出。

prompt.en: What is Z[2] for ababa?
prompt.zh: ababa的Z[2]是多少？

explanation.en: It agrees with the first three symbols.

prompt.en: A rolling-hash collision is impossible for arbitrary strings.
prompt.zh: 任意字符串都不可能发生滚动哈希碰撞。

explanation.en: Different strings can map to the same residue, so equality is not a proof.
explanation.zh: 不同串可映射为同一余数，因此相等不是证明。

summary.en: A trie stores many strings by sharing common prefixes.
summary.zh: 字典树通过共享前缀保存多个串，每条边增加符号，终止标记表示完整模式。

objectives.zh: 说明共享前缀及其条件。

objectives.en: Use failure suffix in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用失配后缀。

body.en: A trie stores many strings by sharing common prefixes. Every edge adds a symbol, and terminal marks indicate complete stored patterns. A terminal node may have descendants because one word can prefix another. Searching a stored word follows its symbols from the root and checks the final terminal mark.
body.zh: 字典树通过共享前缀保存多个串，每条边增加符号，终止标记表示完整模式。终止点仍可有后代，因为一个词可为另一个词的前缀。查词沿字符从根走并检查末点标记。

body.en: Aho–Corasick adds failure links to the longest proper suffix that is also a trie prefix. Construct links breadth-first so shorter suffix information is ready. During text scanning, mismatches follow failure links until a usable transition appears or the root is reached. Output links or accumulated terminal information report suffix patterns as well.
body.zh: AC添加到最长真后缀且为字典树前缀的失配链接。按广搜建立，保证短后缀信息已就绪。失配时沿链接找到可转移处或根；输出链接或终止信息累积还需报告后缀模式。

body.en: For patterns he, she, hers, scanning ushers reaches the end of she. The failure chain also exposes he ending at the same position. Continuing the scan finds hers. Reporting only the current node’s pattern would miss he, while discarding the active suffix after she would obstruct the later longer continuation.
body.zh: he、she、hers匹配ushers，到she末点时失配链也显示同位置结束的he，继续可找到hers。只报告当前节点会漏he；she后丢弃活动后缀又可能妨碍后续延伸。

body.en: Dense transition tables use nodes times alphabet-size storage; sparse maps save space but add lookup costs. Reporting all matches requires time proportional to the number reported, which may exceed text length greatly. Duplicate inserted patterns need an explicit counting policy. Separate transition-processing time from output cost when analyzing the algorithm’s total complexity.
body.zh: 稠密转移表空间为节点数乘字母表大小，稀疏映射省空间但增加查询代价。全部输出耗时至少与匹配数成正比，可能远超文本长。重复模式需明确计数政策，复杂度应区分转移与输出。

prompt.en: How many patterns among he, she, hers occur in ushers?
prompt.zh: he、she、hers中多少个出现在ushers？

hints.en: Allow overlapping matches.
hints.zh: 允许重叠匹配。

explanation.en: All three occur, with he and she sharing an ending position.
explanation.zh: 三者均出现，he与she结束位置相同。

prompt.en: A trie terminal node must always be a leaf.
prompt.zh: 字典树终止节点总是叶子。

text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.zh: 一个词可为另一词前缀。

explanation.en: he is terminal even if descendants spell hers.
explanation.zh: 即使后代拼出hers，he节点仍是终止点。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

title.zh: 后缀数组与最长公共前缀

summary.en: A suffix array lists suffix starting indices in lexicographic order.
summary.zh: 后缀数组按字典序列出后缀起点，每个后缀为起点后的完整尾部。

objectives.en: Explain suffix order with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明后缀序及其条件。

objectives.en: Use rank doubling in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用排名倍增。

body.en: A suffix array lists suffix starting indices in lexicographic order. Each suffix is the complete tail from its starting position. Suffixes beginning with a fixed pattern occupy one contiguous interval, enabling binary searches for occurrences. The array stores positions; it need not copy every suffix, which would require quadratic total character storage.
body.zh: 后缀数组按字典序列出后缀起点，每个后缀为起点后的完整尾部。同模式开头的后缀占连续区间，可二分查询。只存位置，不必复制所有后缀，否则字符总空间为二次。

body.en: Doubling ranks substrings of lengths one, two, four, and onward. A length-2k substring is described by ranks of its two k-length halves, with a special smaller rank beyond the end. Sorting these pairs refines the order until complete suffixes are distinguished. Efficient rank-pair sorting determines the construction’s precise running time.
body.zh: 倍增给长1、2、4等子串排名，长2k由两个k半段排名描述，越界用更小特殊排名。排序排名对不断细化直到区分后缀；排名对排序方法决定具体复杂度。

body.en: For banana, suffix order is [5,3,1,0,4,2]: a, ana, anana, banana, na, nana. Adjacent LCP lengths are 1,3,0,0,2. There are 21 positional nonempty substrings, but subtracting repeated-prefix contributions gives 21−6=15 distinct substrings. Each new suffix contributes only prefixes longer than its LCP with its predecessor.
body.zh: banana后缀序[5,3,1,0,4,2]对应a、ana、anana、banana、na、nana，相邻LCP为1、3、0、0、2。按位置非空子串21个，减重复前缀6后不同子串15个；新后缀只贡献超过前驱LCP的前缀。

body.en: The LCP of two suffixes equals the minimum adjacent LCP across the interval between their ranks. This reduces repeated common-prefix queries to range minima. A linear LCP algorithm reuses the fact that dropping one initial character decreases a known common prefix by at most one. Keep string positions separate from suffix ranks throughout every index calculation.
body.zh: 两后缀LCP等于其排名区间相邻LCP最小值，因此转成区间最小查询。线性LCP算法利用去掉首字符使已知公共前缀至多减一。所有下标计算都要区分原串位置和后缀排名。

prompt.en: How many distinct nonempty substrings does banana have?
prompt.zh: banana有多少不同非空子串？

hints.en: Subtract the adjacent LCP sum from 21.
hints.zh: 用21减相邻LCP之和。

prompt.en: Suffixes sharing a fixed prefix form a contiguous suffix-array block.
prompt.zh: 共享固定前缀的后缀在后缀数组中连续。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.zh: 看字典序首次不同的字符。

explanation.en: A different earlier prefix cannot fall between two suffixes with the full common prefix.
explanation.zh: 较早字符已不同的后缀不能夹在完整共享前缀的两者间。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

title.en: Suffix automata and string problem synthesis
title.zh: 后缀自动机与字符串综合

summary.en: A suffix automaton groups substrings with identical sets of ending positions in the text.
summary.zh: 后缀自动机把文本中结束位置集合相同的子串归类。

objectives.en: Explain end-position class with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明结束位置类及其条件。

objectives.en: Use suffix link in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用后缀链接。

body.en: A suffix automaton groups substrings with identical sets of ending positions in the text. One state can represent several substring lengths. Its maximum length is len[v], while its suffix link points toward the next shorter ending-position class. Character transitions extend represented substrings and permit recognition of every substring starting from the initial state.
body.zh: 后缀自动机把文本中结束位置集合相同的子串归类。状态可表示多个长度，最大为len[v]，后缀链接指向下一较短结束位置类。字符转移延长子串，从初态可识别所有子串。

body.en: A noninitial state represents lengths len[link[v]]+1 through len[v]. Therefore it contributes len[v]−len[link[v]] distinct substrings. Online extension adds transitions along suffix links. When one class would incorrectly combine incompatible length ranges, cloning splits it while preserving existing accepted paths; the clone is structural, not a newly observed text ending.
body.zh: 非初态表示len[link[v]]+1至len[v]，贡献两者差个不同子串。在线扩展沿后缀链接补转移；若类错误混合长度范围，就克隆拆分并保持旧路径。克隆是结构调整，不是新增文本结束位置。

body.en: In aba, distinct nonempty substrings are a,b,ab,ba,aba, giving five. To test a query pattern, follow its characters from the initial state; a missing transition rejects it. To count occurrences, initialize direct ending contributions and propagate them through suffix links from longer states to shorter states, so suffix occurrences accumulate correctly.
body.zh: aba不同非空子串是a、b、ab、ba、aba，共五个。查询从初态沿字符走，缺转移即不存在。计出现次数时初始化直接结束贡献，再按长度递减沿后缀链接累加，使后缀正确接收次数。

body.en: For a fixed alphabet, automaton size and construction work are linear; associative containers introduce their own lookup costs. Choose the simplest sufficient tool: KMP for one pattern, Aho–Corasick for many patterns, suffix structures for many substring queries. Their similarly named links encode different equivalence relations, so construction rules and correctness arguments cannot be exchanged casually.
body.zh: 固定字母表下规模和建造线性，关联容器另有查询代价。单模式可选KMP、多模式AC、大量子串查询用后缀结构。相似名称的链接编码不同等价关系，不能随意交换构造与证明。

prompt.en: How many distinct nonempty substrings does aba have?
prompt.zh: aba有多少不同非空子串？

hints.en: List lengths one, two, and three.
hints.zh: 按长度一、二、三列举。

explanation.en: Two one-letter, two two-letter, and one three-letter substring give five.
explanation.zh: 一字两种、两字两种、三字一种，共五种。

prompt.en: Each suffix-automaton state represents exactly one substring length.
prompt.zh: 后缀自动机每状态恰代表一个长度。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.zh: 它代表一个长度区间。

explanation.en: The interval can contain several lengths with the same ending-position set.
explanation.zh: 相同结束位置集合的区间可含多个长度。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: For a positive integer m, a and b are congruent modulo m when m divides a−b.
summary.zh: 对正整数 m，如果 m 整除 a−b，就称 a 与 b 模 m 同余，即二者之差是 m 的整数倍。

objectives.en: Explain residue with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明剩余类及其条件。

objectives.en: Use inverse in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用逆元。

body.en: For a positive integer m, a and b are congruent modulo m when m divides a−b. This means their difference is a whole multiple of m. For example, 17 and 5 are congruent modulo 12. A canonical representative can be chosen from 0 through m−1.
body.zh: 对正整数 m，如果 m 整除 a−b，就称 a 与 b 模 m 同余，即二者之差是 m 的整数倍。例如 17 与 5 模 12 同余。可以从 0 到 m−1 选择标准代表元。

body.en: Replacing a value by a congruent one preserves the final remainder of sums and products. Therefore intermediate results can often be reduced modulo m. This does not automatically prevent overflow: the product must first be representable, or a safe multiplication method must be used.
body.zh: 把数替换为与它同余的数，不会改变和或积的最终余数，因此常可在中间步骤取模。但这不自动防止溢出：乘积仍必须先能被表示，或者使用安全的乘法方法。

body.en: The mathematical representative of −1 modulo 5 is 4. C++ remainder follows its integer-division rule and gives −1 % 5 equal to −1. With m positive, r = a % m; if (r < 0) r += m; produces a value in [0,m). This conditional form avoids an unnecessary addition for already nonnegative remainders.
body.zh: −1 模 5 的数学标准代表元是 4。C++ 的余数遵循整数除法规则，−1 % 5 得到 −1。m 为正时，先算 r = a % m;，若 r < 0 再加 m，就得到 [0,m) 中的值。这个写法不会给已经非负的余数做不必要的加法。

body.en: To divide by a modulo m, one needs a multiplicative inverse: a value u with au congruent to 1. Such an inverse exists exactly when gcd(a,m)=1. For example, 2 has no inverse modulo 6 because every 2u is even and cannot differ from 1 by a multiple of 6. Never replace division by an inverse without checking the condition.
body.zh: 模 m 除以 a，需要乘法逆元，即使 au 模 m 同余于 1 的 u。逆元存在的充要条件是 gcd(a,m)=1。例如 2 在模 6 下没有逆元，因为 2u 总为偶数，不可能与 1 相差 6 的倍数。不能不检查条件就把除法换成逆元。

body.en: Binary exponentiation squares a power repeatedly and multiplies it into the answer for each set exponent bit, using O(log k) multiplications for exponent k. An inverse of a modulo m exists exactly when gcd(a,m)=1. Normalize negative remainders, and use sufficiently wide intermediate products; a final small residue does not make an overflowing multiplication valid.
body.zh: 快速幂反复平方，在指数位为1时乘入答案，指数k需O(log k)次乘法。a模m逆元存在当且仅当gcd(a,m)=1。负余数需规范化，中间乘积要足够宽，最终余数小不能使溢出合法。

prompt.en: What is the representative of −3 modulo 7 in [0,7)?
prompt.zh: −3 模 7 在 [0,7) 中的标准代表元是多少？

hints.en: Add one multiple of 7.
hints.zh: 加上一个 7 的倍数。

prompt.en: Which number in {0,1,2,3,4} is the inverse of 2 modulo 5?

hints.en: Find u such that 2u leaves remainder 1 after division by 5.
hints.zh: 寻找使 2u 除以 5 余 1 的 u。

explanation.en: 2 × 3 = 6 ≡ 1 (mod 5), so 3 is the inverse.

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: The sieve of Eratosthenes crosses out multiples of each unmarked prime.
summary.zh: 埃氏筛划去未标记素数的倍数，从p²开始即可，因为更小倍数已遇到更小素因子。

objectives.en: Explain prime sieve with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明素数筛及其条件。

objectives.en: Use totient in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用欧拉函数。

body.en: The sieve of Eratosthenes crosses out multiples of each unmarked prime. Starting at p² is sufficient because smaller multiples have already met a smaller prime factor. A table through N supports queries only inside its proved range; it is not a universal primality test for larger inputs.
body.zh: 埃氏筛划去未标记素数的倍数，从p²开始即可，因为更小倍数已遇到更小素因子。筛到N只支持证明范围内查询，并非任意大数素性测试。

body.en: Euler’s phi(n) counts integers from one through n coprime to n. Its formula is n∏(1−1/p) over distinct prime divisors. The Möbius function mu is zero when a prime square divides n; otherwise it is (−1)^k for k distinct prime factors, with mu(1)=1.
body.zh: φ(n)统计1到n中互素者，公式为不同素因子上的n∏(1−1/p)。含素数平方因子时μ(n)=0，否则为(−1)^k，k是不同素因子数，μ(1)=1。

body.en: For twelve, phi(12)=12×(1/2)×(2/3)=4, corresponding to 1,5,7,11. Also mu(12)=0 because four divides twelve, whereas mu(6)=1. Multiplicativity means f(ab)=f(a)f(b) only for coprime a and b; applying it without that condition gives incorrect values even for small integers.

If F(n)=Σd|n f(d), inversion gives f(n)=Σd|n mu(d)F(n/d). Expanding and regrouping works because the divisor sum of mu equals one at n=1 and zero otherwise. Preserve the divisor relation carefully: a sum over divisors is different from a sum over all smaller integers or a prefix-sum array.
body.zh: 若F(n)=Σd|n f(d)，则f(n)=Σd|n μ(d)F(n/d)。展开重组利用μ的约数和：n=1为1，否则为0。约数和不同于对所有较小整数求和，不能误换成前缀和。

prompt.en: What is phi(12)?
prompt.zh: φ(12)是多少？

hints.en: List the coprime integers.
hints.zh: 列出互素整数。

explanation.en: 1,5,7,11 give four.

prompt.en: What is mu(18)?
prompt.zh: μ(18)是多少？

hints.en: Nine divides eighteen.

explanation.en: A squared prime factor forces zero.
explanation.zh: 含素数平方因子，所以为0。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: Define precisely which objects are distinct and whether order matters.
summary.zh: 先定义对象如何区分、顺序是否重要。

objectives.en: Explain counting rules with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明计数原理及其条件。

objectives.en: Use coefficient encoding in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用系数编码。

body.en: Define precisely which objects are distinct and whether order matters. Add counts for disjoint alternatives and multiply counts for successive choices with fixed continuation counts. A generating function stores a sequence as coefficients of powers of a formal variable. It is an algebraic record, not necessarily a function requiring numerical evaluation.
body.zh: 先定义对象如何区分、顺序是否重要。互斥方案相加，后续数量固定的连续选择相乘。生成函数把序列存为形式变量幂的系数，是代数记录，不一定需要数值代入。

body.en: An item of weight w usable once contributes the factor 1+x^w, representing omission or inclusion. Multiplying factors combines choices; the coefficient of x^t counts subsets of total weight t. Unlimited indistinguishable copies contribute 1+x^w+x^(2w)+… instead. Changing this factor changes the combinatorial model, not merely an optimization.
body.zh: 重量w至多一次对应1+x^w，分别表示不选与选。乘因子组合选择，x^t系数数总重t的子集。无限不可区分副本对应1+x^w+x^(2w)+⋯；改变因子就是改变计数模型。

body.en: For weights one, two, three, the product (1+x)(1+x²)(1+x³) has x³ coefficient two. One contribution chooses the weight-three item; another chooses one and two. Polynomial coefficient multiplication is convolution, the same operation used by a counting DP when combining independently chosen groups with additive totals.
body.zh: 重量1、2、3的积(1+x)(1+x²)(1+x³)中x³系数为2，来自选3或选1和2。系数乘法就是卷积，也是计数DP合并独立组、累加总量时的操作。

body.en: Binomial coefficients satisfy C(n,k)=C(n−1,k)+C(n−1,k−1), partitioning subsets by whether they contain a distinguished item. Modular factorial division requires invertible denominators and may fail for composite moduli. An integer recurrence avoids that issue. Implemented formal series must also specify truncation so discarded degrees cannot later influence any coefficient being requested.
body.zh: 按是否含指定元素分割得C(n,k)=C(n−1,k)+C(n−1,k−1)。模阶乘除法要求分母可逆，合数模可能失败，整数递推可避免。实现幂级数还需指定截断，保证丢掉高次不会影响所求系数。

prompt.en: What is the x³ coefficient in (1+x)(1+x²)(1+x³)?
prompt.zh: 该乘积的x³系数是多少？

hints.en: Find subsets totaling three.
hints.zh: 找总和3的子集。

explanation.en: {3} and {1,2} each contribute one.

prompt.en: Division modulo every positive modulus is always valid.
prompt.zh: 任意正整数模数下除法总合法。

text.en: True
text.zh: 正确

text.en: False
text.zh: 错误

hints.en: Check whether the divisor has an inverse.
hints.zh: 检查除数是否有逆元。

explanation.en: A divisor sharing a factor with the modulus is not invertible.
explanation.zh: 除数与模数有公因子时不可逆。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: A linear recurrence can be encoded as a state vector transformed by a matrix.
summary.zh: 线性递推可编码为矩阵变换状态向量。

objectives.en: Explain transition matrix with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明转移矩阵及其条件。

objectives.en: Use matrix powers in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用矩阵幂。

body.en: A linear recurrence can be encoded as a state vector transformed by a matrix. Fibonacci updates [F(n),F(n−1)] to [F(n)+F(n−1),F(n)] using rows [1,1] and [1,0]. The state must contain every quantity needed for the next update; missing history cannot be repaired by matrix multiplication alone.
body.zh: 线性递推可编码为矩阵变换状态向量。矩阵行[1,1]和[1,0]把[F(n),F(n−1)]变为[F(n)+F(n−1),F(n)]。状态必须包含下一更新全部信息，缺少历史不能靠矩阵自动补救。

body.en: Exponentiation by squaring computes the nth power in O(log n) matrix multiplications. Elementary dense multiplication costs O(k³) for dimension k. Multiplication order matters because matrices generally do not commute. Include auxiliary sums as additional coordinates when they themselves update linearly, and choose the identity matrix as the zero-power base case.
body.zh: 快速幂用O(log n)次矩阵乘法求n次幂，普通k维乘法O(k³)。矩阵通常不交换，顺序重要。若辅助和也线性更新可增加坐标，零次幂以单位矩阵为基。

body.en: An XOR linear basis treats bit vectors as vectors over the two-element field. Eliminate the highest set bit with an existing pivot; retain a remaining new pivot as independent. For 3=011 and 5=101, their XOR equals 6=110. Thus adding six to these two vectors does not increase rank.
body.zh: 异或线性基把位向量当二元域向量，用已有主元消最高1位，剩新主元才独立。3=011与5=101异或为6=110，所以加入6不增加秩。

body.en: A rank-r XOR span contains 2^r distinct vectors, including zero. This uses XOR, not ordinary integer addition. A basis supports representation and optimization tasks only after its pivot invariant is established. Nonlinear recurrences, such as squaring the preceding value, do not automatically become linear by choosing a larger matrix without a closed finite state representation.
body.zh: 秩r的异或空间有2^r个向量，包括零，运算是异或而非整数加法。必须建立主元不变量才可表示或优化。前项平方等非线性递推，若无封闭有限状态，不能随意用大矩阵线性化。

prompt.en: What is the XOR rank of {3,5,6}?
prompt.zh: {3,5,6}的异或秩是多少？

hints.en: 3 XOR 5 is 6.
hints.zh: 3异或5等于6。

explanation.en: Only two vectors are independent.
explanation.zh: 只有两个向量独立。

prompt.en: How many vectors belong to a rank-three XOR span?
prompt.zh: 秩3异或空间有多少向量？

hints.en: Each coefficient is zero or one.
hints.zh: 每系数为0或1。

explanation.en: 2^3=8 independent coefficient choices produce distinct vectors.
explanation.zh: 2^3=8种独立系数选择对应不同向量。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: Polynomial multiplication yields c[k]=Σa[i]b[k−i], called convolution.
summary.zh: 多项式乘法得到卷积c[k]=Σa[i]b[k−i]，系数对贡献于次数之和。

objectives.en: Explain convolution with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明卷积及其条件。

objectives.en: Use evaluation in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用求值。

body.en: Polynomial multiplication yields c[k]=Σa[i]b[k−i], called convolution. Each coefficient pair contributes to the sum of its degrees. Direct multiplication is quadratic for equal-length arrays. Evaluating both polynomials at sufficiently many distinct points turns the multiplication into pointwise products; interpolation then recovers the coefficient representation.
body.zh: 多项式乘法得到卷积c[k]=Σa[i]b[k−i]，系数对贡献于次数之和。等长数组直接乘为二次时间。足够多不同点求值后逐点相乘，再插值恢复系数。

body.en: FFT evaluates at structured complex roots of unity by recursively splitting even and odd coefficients. NTT uses corresponding roots in a finite field for exact modular operations. Under prime modulus p, transform length L must divide p−1 and the chosen root must have exact order L. Not every convenient modulus supports every length.
body.zh: FFT在复单位根上按奇偶系数递归求值，NTT在有限域对应根上精确模运算。素数模p下L须整除p−1，根的阶须恰为L。并非任意模数都支持任意长度。

body.en: Multiplying (1+2x)(3+4x) gives coefficients [3,10,8]. The transform length must be at least three, commonly padded to four. Without enough zeros, high-degree coefficients wrap around through cyclic convolution. The inverse transform reverses the root direction and includes multiplication by the inverse of the transform length in the modular setting.
body.zh: (1+2x)(3+4x)得[3,10,8]，变换长度至少3，常补到4。不足补零会让高次系数经循环卷积绕回。逆变换反向用根，并在模环境乘以长度的逆元。

body.en: Complex FFT introduces rounding error, so rounding back to integers needs a justified precision bound. NTT returns residues, not unrestricted integer coefficients. Exact large-integer reconstruction may need several compatible moduli with a product exceeding the coefficient bound. Both approaches still require safe intermediate multiplication and explicit treatment of input length, padding, and normalization.
body.zh: 复FFT有舍入误差，恢复整数需精度界。NTT只返回余数，不是无限整数系数；精确恢复大系数可能需要多个兼容模数，乘积超过系数界。二者都要安全中间乘法并明确长度、补零和归一化。

sources.title: MIT: Design and Analysis of Algorithms

summary.en: Expected value is a probability-weighted sum of numerical outcomes.
summary.zh: 期望是结果按概率加权的和。

objectives.en: Explain expectation with its conditions.
objectives.zh: 说明期望及其条件。

objectives.en: Use winning state in a worked problem.
objectives.zh: 在问题中应用必胜态。

body.en: Expected value is a probability-weighted sum of numerical outcomes. Linearity says E(X+Y)=E(X)+E(Y) whenever expectations exist, even if variables are dependent. Indicator variables, equal to one when an event occurs and zero otherwise, turn a complicated count into a sum whose expectation can often be calculated term by term.
body.zh: 期望是结果按概率加权的和。存在期望时E(X+Y)=E(X)+E(Y)，不要求独立。事件发生为1否则为0的指示变量，可把复杂计数变为逐项求期望的和。

body.en: In finite impartial normal-play games, both players have the same available moves and a player with no move loses. A state is winning if some move reaches a losing state; it is losing if every move reaches a winning state. This recursion requires termination, usually ensured by a strictly decreasing resource.
body.zh: 有限无偏正常玩法中双方操作相同，无步可走者输。可一步到必败则当前必胜；所有步到必胜则当前必败。递推要求终止，通常用严格递减资源保证。

body.en: If each move removes one or two stones, zero is losing, one and two are winning, and three is losing. Induction makes every multiple of three losing. In a separate probability example, two fair coin tosses have expected one head because the two indicators each contribute one-half, regardless of how their expectations are added.
body.zh: 每次拿一或两石，0必败，1和2必胜，3必败；归纳得3的倍数必败。另看两次公平抛硬币，每次正面指示变量期望1/2，总正面数期望1。

body.en: The Grundy number of an impartial terminating state is the mex, the smallest absent nonnegative integer, of successor values. Independent component games combine by XOR. Partisan moves, reversed winning rules, and cyclic games need different analysis. Always translate the actual move and ending rules before applying a remembered Nim formula or probabilistic shortcut.
body.zh: 终止无偏状态的SG值为后继值的mex，即最小未出现非负整数；独立分量用异或合并。双方不同操作、反常胜负和含环游戏需另析。套Nim公式或概率捷径前，必须先翻译真实规则。
